SELECT
  pos_order.shop_id base_shop_id,
  pos_order.order_date base_date,
  SUM(pos_cash.money_actual) calc_data 
FROM
  pos_order_rela pos_order
  LEFT JOIN pos_cash_rela pos_cash ON pos_order.app_id = pos_cash.app_id 
  AND pos_order.third_order_id = pos_cash.third_order_id 
  AND pos_cash.is_del = 0 
  AND pos_order.order_date = pos_cash.account_date 
WHERE
  1 = 1 
  AND pos_order.is_del = 0 
  AND pos_order.STATUS IN (1, 2, 3, 4) 
  AND pos_order.order_date >= '2026-02-26' 
  AND pos_order.order_date <= '2026-02-26' 
  AND pos_cash.account_date >= '2026-02-26' 
  AND pos_cash.account_date <= '2026-02-26'

  pos_order.shop_id,
  pos_order.order_date

select
         
            btpt.business_unit_code,
            btp.id,
            btp.poi_id,
            btp.poi_name,
            btp.province,
            btp.adcode_province,
            btp.city,
            btp.adcode_city,
            btp.district,
            btp.adcode_district,
            btp.town,
            btp.adcode_town,
            btp.village,
            btp.village_code,
            btp.poi_address,
            btp.longitude,
            btp.latitude,
            btp.channel_type,
            btp.channel_second_type,
            btp.amap_channel_type,
            btp.amap_second_type,
            btp.shop_distribution,
            case btp.chain_or_not
            when '1' then '是'
            when '0' then ''
            else '' end as chain_or_not,
            btp.brand_name,
            btp.business_circle,
            btp.env_code_merge,
            btp.env_name_merge,
            btp.yuntu_tag,
            case btp.heat_type
            when '1' then '否'
            when '0' then '是'
            else '' end as heat_type,
            case btp.heat_value
            when -1.00 then NULL
            else FLOOR(btp.heat_value)
            end as heat_value,
            case btp.rating
            when -1.00 then NULL
            else btp.rating
            end as rating,
            btp.open_time,
            btp.tel,
            case btp.collection_time when '-1' then '' else btp.collection_time end as collection_time,
            btp.head_photo,
            case btp.dairy_products_mlz when -1.00 then NULL else btp.dairy_products_mlz end as dairy_products_Mlz,
            btp.potentiality_score,
            case btp.push_status
            when '是' then '已推送'
            else '未推送' end as push_status,
            btp.modified_time,
            concat(btpt.id,'-',btpt.task_name) as task_name,
            brc.card_name,
            btp.shop_area,
            case btp.regional_high_credibility
            when 1 then '是'
            when 0 then '否'
            else btp.regional_high_credibility end as regionalHighCredibilityStr
     
        from busi_top_poi btp
        left join
        busi_top_poi_task btpt on btpt.id = btp.task_id
        left join
        busi_rating_card brc on brc.id = btpt.rating_card_id
         
          WHERE btp.delete_flag = 0
           and btp.show_flag = 1
           and btpt.business_unit_code='1-253CQ3' 
     
        order by btp.modified_time desc,btp.id desc LIMIT 10

        trade.platform_tid,trade.merge_key,trade.woda_flag,trade.is_merge,
        trade.woda_trade_status, trade.express_printed_num, trade.send_invoice_printed_num,
        trade.unable_merge, trade.exception_type, trade.is_cod, trade.added_services,
        trade.receiver_modify, trade.is_split, trade.lock_status, trade.is_pre_sale,
        trade.is_pre_send,trade.shipping_type,trade.trade_attribute, trade.receiver_name,
        trade.receiver_state, trade.receiver_city, trade.receiver_address,
        (CAST(trade.ext_json->>'$.oaid' AS CHAR(100))) as oaid, (CAST(trade.ext_json->>'$.oaid2' AS CHAR(100))) as oaid2

        ,trade.search_buyer_nick, trade.search_receiver_name, trade.search_receiver_phone,
        trade.search_receiver_mobile, trade.receiver_country,trade.receiver_district,
        trade.receiver_town, trade.search_receiver_address
     
        from edge_biz.woda_trade trade
        INNER JOIN edge_biz.search_woda_trade search
        on trade.woda_tid = search.woda_tid
        and trade.woda_shop_id = search.woda_shop_id
        where
        trade.woda_shop_id = search.woda_shop_id
        and search.woda_shop_id = 6286121
        and ((CAST(trade.ext_json->>'$.oaid' AS CHAR(100))) = 'MjwrU7e6gXyQAWKn2yryEN5sl+qnuUrqmWrNIqsmzOd8XV4w3Q6KMz7v4U7YuzQv'
         
            or (CAST(trade.ext_json->>'$.oaid2' AS CHAR(100))) = 'fnOkPdMsmyS1d/5pop2kUCpkKXzTly2yETKsJvd01mR8XV4w3Q6KMz7v4U7YuzQv'
         
        )
        and trade.warehouse_id = 23077
        and trade.is_reviewed = 1
        and trade.woda_trade_status = 1
        and trade.has_refund = 0
        and trade.express_printed_num = 0
        and trade.send_invoice_printed_num = 0
        and trade.unable_merge in (0,2)
        and trade.exception_type = 1
         
            and trade.shipping_type = 0
         
        and trade.lock_status = 0
        and trade.is_split = 0
        and trade.is_cod = 0
        and trade.receiver_modify = 0
        and trade.main_trade = 1
        and trade.status = 1
        and search.status = 1
          and search.trade_count < 200  
        order by trade.woda_tid

SELECT 
	store_id,store_name,ys,ss,TRUNCATE(profit,2) AS profit,
	CONCAT(TRUNCATE((profit/ys)*100,2),'%') AS ys_profit,
	CONCAT(TRUNCATE((profit/ss)*100,2),'%') AS ss_profit
	FROM(
		SELECT
			a.store_id,
			a.store_name,
			SUM( a.sales_amount + a.discount_amount ) AS ys,
			SUM( a.sales_amount ) AS ss,
			SUM(a.sales_amount*(a.discount_rate/100)) AS profit
		FROM
			sales_goods_report a
		WHERE a.store_id IS NOT NULL
        /*CONDITION*/
		GROUP BY a.store_id
	) tmp
	 limit 5

select exists(select * from `member_1` where `saas_id` = '2495703' and `shop_type` = '0' and `super_shop_id` = '0' and `member_id` = '5971946036464645' and `business_time` between '1735660800' and '1767196800' and `type` = '12') as `exists`

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
	SELECT t1.xmbm AS bm, t1.xmmc, t1.xmfzr
		, (
			SELECT group_concat(lastname)
			FROM hrmresource h
			WHERE concat(',', concat(t1.xmfzr, ',')) LIKE concat('%', concat(concat(',', concat(h.ID, ',')), '%'))
		) AS lastname
	FROM uf_xmgltz t1
	WHERE t1.sddr IS NULL
		AND (xmzt = 1
			OR xmzt IS NULL)
) weaver
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT 
			r.id,
			r.template_code,
			( SELECT t.`name` FROM pf_email_template t WHERE t.`code` = r.template_code ORDER BY t.deleted ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS template_name,
			r.business_id,
			r.`subject`,
			r.content,
			r.from_email,
			r.to_email,
			r.create_time,
			r.`status`,
			r.report_msg,
			r.app_id,
			r.template_content_id
		FROM 
			pf_email_record r
		WHERE 
			1 = 1
		 
		 
			AND r.business_id = 1
		 
		 
		 
		 
		 
		 
		 
		ORDER BY
			r.create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT *
FROM (
	SELECT t1.xmbm AS bm, t1.xmmc, t1.xmfzr
		, (
			SELECT group_concat(lastname)
			FROM hrmresource h
			WHERE concat(',', concat(t1.xmfzr, ',')) LIKE concat('%', concat(concat(',', concat(h.ID, ',')), '%'))
		) AS lastname
	FROM uf_xmgltz t1
	WHERE t1.sddr IS NULL
		AND (xmzt = 1
			OR xmzt IS NULL)
) weaver
WHERE 1 = 1
	AND xmmc LIKE '%25%'
ORDER BY bm, xmmc
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, project_dept_id, project_dept_name, waybill_type, CASE (waybill_type) WHEN 1 THEN concat(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag != 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2), '%') ELSE '-' END AS match_rate, CASE (waybill_type) WHEN 1 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE '-' END AS match_sum, CASE (waybill_type) WHEN 1 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag != 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE '-' END AS total_sum, SUM(contract_fee) AS sum_contract_fee, SUM(dispatch_fee) AS sum_dispatch_fee, concat(ROUND((SUM(contract_fee) - SUM(dispatch_fee)) / SUM(contract_fee) * 100, 2), '%') AS gross_profit_rate FROM jvms_waybill WHERE (del_flag = 0 AND customer_name = '上海中远海' AND waybill_status <> 3 AND check_status = 2 AND initial_flag = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-03-10 23:59:59' AND project_dept_id IN (853732492)) AND (1 = 0 OR project_dept_id IN (853732491, 853732492, 853932375, 854013139, 857327656, 912600583) OR project_dept_id IN (853563759, 853651606, 853683536, 853729500, 853732491, 853732492, 853776415, 853932375, 853992128, 854013139, 857327655, 857327656, 857768098, 857768099, 857801045, 912554609, 912580552, 912600583, 931290698)) GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name, project_dept_id, project_dept_name, waybill_type ORDER BY customer_name DESC) TOTAL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ((SELECT t1.id, t1.order_no, t1.order_status, t1.project_dept_id, t1.invoice_status, t1.customer_id, t1.customer_name, t1.contract_company_id, t1.contract_company_name, t1.total_fee, t1.invoice_fee, t1.no_invoice_fee, (t1.total_fee - t1.invoice_fee - t1.no_invoice_fee) AS remain_fee, t1.create_time, 1 AS order_type FROM tms_order t1 WHERE (t1.del_flag = '0') ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC) UNION ALL (SELECT t1.id, t1.order_no, t1.order_status, t1.project_dept_id, t1.invoice_status, t1.customer_id, t1.customer_name, t1.contract_company_id, t1.contract_company_name, t1.contract_fee AS total_fee, t1.invoice_fee, t1.no_invoice_fee, (t1.contract_fee - t1.invoice_fee - t1.no_invoice_fee) AS remain_fee, t1.create_time, 2 AS order_type FROM tms_other_order t1 WHERE (t1.del_flag = '0') ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC)) temp WHERE (1 = 0 OR project_dept_id IN (853724466, 853770482, 853820408, 853873494))

SELECT
            store_code,
            store_name,
            TRUNCATE(amount / 10000,0) AS amount,
            IF(plan > amount,(amount/plan)*100,100) AS completeRate
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    store_code,
                    store_name,
                    SUM( pay_amount ) AS amount,
                    IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SALES) FROM jpaas_erp.erp_plan_floor WHERE MALL = store_code),0.00) AS plan
                FROM
                    erp_sales_report
                WHERE store_code IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY store_code ORDER BY amount DESC
            ) tmp

select
           sfoi.bidding_id as biddingId,
           sfoi.require_id as requireId,
           sfoi.sf_order_status as sfOrderStatus,
           sfoi.sf_no as sfNo,
           sfoi.order_no as orderNo,
           sfoi.quote_status as quoteStatus,
           sfoi.final_price as finalPrice,
           sfoi.tms_price as tmsPrice,
           sfoi.markup_price as markupPrice,
           sfoi.insurance_price as insurancePrice,
           sfoi.pickup_price as pickupPrice,
           sfoi.delivery_price as deliveryPrice,
           sfoi.other_price as otherPrice,
           sfoi.timeliness_days as timelinessDays,
           sfoi.origin_province_name as originProvinceName,
           sfoi.origin_city_name as originCityName,
           sfoi.origin_district_name as originDistrictName,
           sfoi.dest_province_name as destProvinceName,
           sfoi.dest_city_name as destCityName,
           sfoi.dest_district_name as destDistrictName,
           sfoi.car_value as carValue,
           sfoi.pickup_car_type as pickupCarType,
           sfoi.delivery_car_type as deliveryCarType,
           sfoi.origin_station_region_name as originStationRegionName,
           sfoi.quote_time as quoteTime,
           sfoi.offer_time as offerTime,
           sfoi.order_received_time as orderReceivedTime,
           sfoi.order_create_time as orderCreateTime,
           sfoi.file_urls,
           sfoi.vin_no,
           sfoi.car_plate_order,
            sfoi.is_pickup_info_uploaded,
            (case sfoi.is_pickup_info_uploaded when 0 then '否' when 1 then '是' end)isPickupInfoUploadedName,
            sfoi.pickup_name,
            sfoi.pickup_phone,
            sfoi.is_delivery_info_uploaded,
            (case sfoi.is_delivery_info_uploaded when 0 then '否' when 1 then '是' end)isDeliveryInfoUploadedName,
            sfoi.delivery_name,
            sfoi.delivery_phone,
            sfoi.delivery_time,
            ( SELECT create_time FROM sf_tms_order_gis_record WHERE order_no = sfoi.order_no AND DATE ( create_time ) = CURDATE() ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) todayUploadTime,
            sfoi.sf_order_info
        from sf_tms_order_info sfoi
         WHERE sfoi.is_order_created=1
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
                and sfoi.dest_province_code = '140000'
            
            
                and sfoi.dest_city_code = '140900' 
        order by sfoi.quote_time desc, sfoi.bidding_id LIMIT 0,10

select
           sfoi.bidding_id as biddingId,
           sfoi.require_id as requireId,
           sfoi.sf_order_status as sfOrderStatus,
           sfoi.sf_no as sfNo,
           sfoi.order_no as orderNo,
           sfoi.quote_status as quoteStatus,
           sfoi.final_price as finalPrice,
           sfoi.tms_price as tmsPrice,
           sfoi.markup_price as markupPrice,
           sfoi.insurance_price as insurancePrice,
           sfoi.pickup_price as pickupPrice,
           sfoi.delivery_price as deliveryPrice,
           sfoi.other_price as otherPrice,
           sfoi.timeliness_days as timelinessDays,
           sfoi.origin_province_name as originProvinceName,
           sfoi.origin_city_name as originCityName,
           sfoi.origin_district_name as originDistrictName,
           sfoi.dest_province_name as destProvinceName,
           sfoi.dest_city_name as destCityName,
           sfoi.dest_district_name as destDistrictName,
           sfoi.car_value as carValue,
           sfoi.pickup_car_type as pickupCarType,
           sfoi.delivery_car_type as deliveryCarType,
           sfoi.origin_station_region_name as originStationRegionName,
           sfoi.quote_time as quoteTime,
           sfoi.offer_time as offerTime,
           sfoi.order_received_time as orderReceivedTime,
           sfoi.order_create_time as orderCreateTime,
           sfoi.file_urls,
           sfoi.vin_no,
           sfoi.car_plate_order,
            sfoi.is_pickup_info_uploaded,
            (case sfoi.is_pickup_info_uploaded when 0 then '否' when 1 then '是' end)isPickupInfoUploadedName,
            sfoi.pickup_name,
            sfoi.pickup_phone,
            sfoi.is_delivery_info_uploaded,
            (case sfoi.is_delivery_info_uploaded when 0 then '否' when 1 then '是' end)isDeliveryInfoUploadedName,
            sfoi.delivery_name,
            sfoi.delivery_phone,
            sfoi.delivery_time,
            ( SELECT create_time FROM sf_tms_order_gis_record WHERE order_no = sfoi.order_no AND DATE ( create_time ) = CURDATE() ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) todayUploadTime,
            sfoi.sf_order_info
        from sf_tms_order_info sfoi
         WHERE sfoi.is_order_created=1
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
                and sfoi.origin_province_code = '210000'
            
            
                and sfoi.origin_city_code = '211300' 
        order by sfoi.quote_time desc, sfoi.bidding_id LIMIT 0,10

SELECT

            (
                SELECT
                    ss.id,
                    ss.auth_status,
                    ss.enable_status,
                    ss.supplier_auth_status,
                    ss.supplier_name,
                    ss.supplier_no,
                    ss.supplier_type,
                    ss.supplier_account,
                    ss.supplier_password,
                    ss.business_type,
                    ss.supplier_phone,
                    ss.password_reset_flag,
                    ss.avatar,
                    ss.parent_id,
                    ss.del_flag,
                    ss.login_time
                FROM
                    `ls-srm`.`srm_supplier` ss
                        LEFT JOIN `ls-tms`.`tms_supplier_waybill` ts ON ss.id = ts.supplier_id
                WHERE
                    ts.waybill_status NOT IN ( 0, 8, 9, 10 )
                  AND ss.del_flag = 0
                  AND ts.del_flag = 0
                  AND DATE_FORMAT( ts.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = '2026-01'
                GROUP BY
                    ss.id UNION
                SELECT
                    ss.id,
                    ss.auth_status,
                    ss.enable_status,
                    ss.supplier_auth_status,
                    ss.supplier_name,
                    ss.supplier_no,
                    ss.supplier_type,
                    ss.supplier_account,
                    ss.supplier_password,
                    ss.business_type,
                    ss.supplier_phone,
                    ss.password_reset_flag,
                    ss.avatar,
                    ss.parent_id,
                    ss.del_flag,
                    ss.login_time
                FROM
                    `ls-srm`.`srm_supplier` ss
                        LEFT JOIN `ls-tms`.`tms_driver_waybill` td ON ss.id = td.supplier_id
                WHERE
                    td.waybill_status NOT IN ( 0, 8, 9, 10 )
                  AND ss.del_flag = 0
                  AND td.del_flag = 0
                  AND DATE_FORMAT( td.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = '2026-01'
                GROUP BY
                    ss.id
            ) t
        GROUP BY
            t.id

select
        a.user_id,
        max(a.channel_id) as channel_id,
        count(*) as spin_times,
        sum(total_bet) as total_bet,
        sum(total_win) as total_win,
        sum(total_bet) - sum(total_win) as total_surplus,
        concat(round(sum(total_win)* 100 / sum(total_bet), 2), '%') as return_rate,
        round(sum(total_bet)/ count(*), 2) as avg_bet,
        from_unixtime(b.last_login_time) as last_login_time

        plug_slots_log.`spin_log_2026-02-10` as a, plug_slots_game.player as b where a.user_id = b.user_id
        and a.user_id not in (select user_id from plug_slots_game.user_white_list)
         
         
         
         
         
             
                    and a.channel_id in (36, 37)
                 
         
         
            and a.theme_id = 36
         

     
        group by
        user_id
        order by spin_times asc
        limit 0, 500

select
        a.user_id,
        max(a.channel_id) as channel_id,
        count(*) as spin_times,
        sum(total_bet) as total_bet,
        sum(total_win) as total_win,
        sum(total_bet) - sum(total_win) as total_surplus,
        concat(round(sum(total_win)* 100 / sum(total_bet), 2), '%') as return_rate,
        round(sum(total_bet)/ count(*), 2) as avg_bet,
        from_unixtime(b.last_login_time) as last_login_time
         
        from
        plug_slots_log.`spin_log_2026-02-11` as a, plug_slots_game.player as b where a.user_id = b.user_id
        and a.user_id not in (select user_id from plug_slots_game.user_white_list)
         
            and spin_time > UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-02-11 19:58:52')
         
         
            and UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-02-12 00:00:00') > spin_time
         
         
         
         
             
                    and a.channel_id in (36, 37)
                 
         
         
            and a.theme_id = 36
         

     
        group by
        user_id
        order by total_bet desc
        limit 0, 500

select SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS 
                    ct.customer_id,
                    customer_name,
                    ifnull(relation_type,0) as relation_type,
                    ifnull(client_ids,0) as client_ids,
                    ifnull(client_adv_ids,0) as client_adv_ids
                from customer_total ct
                left join (
                select   
                    customer_id,
                    acrc.relation_type,acrc.topsign_id ,
                        group_concat(distinct acrc.client_id) as client_ids ,
                        group_concat(distinct acrc.client_id,'-',adv_num) as client_adv_ids from
                ad_customer_relation_collect acrc
                      join (
                        select
                          client_id,
                          count(id) as adv_num
                        from
                          ad_customer_relation_collect
                        where  topsign_id = 1 
                        group by
                          client_id
                      ) as tb on tb.client_id = acrc.client_id
                              group by customer_id,topsign_id
                ) as tb2 on tb2.customer_id = ct.customer_id
                where  ct.is_del = 0 and topsign_id = 1

SELECT a.dept_id AS deptId, 
       SUM(a.isMediaAgree) AS mediaAgreeNum, 
       SUM(a.isContact) AS contactNum,
       SUM(a.caseAmt) AS caseAmt
FROM (
    SELECT ce.dept_id,
           CASE 
               WHEN ce.media_status = 300 AND ce.settle_time >= '2025-07-01' AND ce.settle_time < '2026-01-01' THEN 1
               WHEN cbt.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
               ELSE 0 
           END AS isMediaAgree,
           CASE WHEN ce.long_contact_rst = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isContact,
           CASE 
               WHEN ce.media_status = 300 AND ce.settle_time >= '2025-07-01' AND ce.settle_time < '2026-01-01' THEN ce.case_amt
               WHEN cbt.id IS NOT NULL THEN ce.case_amt
               ELSE 0 
           END AS caseAmt
    FROM case_enforce ce
    LEFT JOIN case_bind_tag cbt ON cbt.case_id = ce.id 
         AND cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101) AND cbt.is_del = 0
         AND cbt.create_date >= '2025-07-01' AND cbt.create_date < '2026-01-01'
    WHERE ce.is_del = 0 AND ce.media_no_self != ''
    GROUP BY ce.id
) a 
GROUP BY a.dept_id

select ord_project.counselor_adm_no,sum(ord_project.record_implant_quantity) as new_record_implant_quantity,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="implantology",IF(
            ord_project.record_actually_deduct_amount = 0,
            COALESCE(ord_project.treat_common_project_actually_amount, 0),
            ord_project.record_actually_deduct_amount
        ),0)) as implant_should_deduct_amount,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="implantology",ord_project.material_predict_cost_amount,0)) as implant_material_predict_cost_amount,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="implantology",ord_project.processing_predict_cost_amount,0)) as implant_processing_predict_cost_amount,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="implantology",ord_project.accessory_predict_cost_amount,0)) as implant_accessory_predict_cost_amount,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="prosthesis",IF(
            ord_project.record_actually_deduct_amount = 0,
            COALESCE(ord_project.treat_common_project_actually_amount, 0),
            ord_project.record_actually_deduct_amount
        ),0)) as prosthesis_should_deduct_amount,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="prosthesis",ord_project.material_predict_cost_amount,0)) as prosthesis_material_predict_cost_amount,sum(if(ord_project.deal_appeal="prosthesis",ord_project.processing_predict_cost_amount,0)) as prosthesis_processing_predict_cost_amount,count(distinct if(bill_status!="refunded", ord_order.patient_no, null)) as new_patient_quantity from `ord_project` inner join `ord_order` on `ord_order`.`order_no` = `ord_project`.`order_no` where `ord_project`.`id` in (select `id` from `ord_project` where (`is_calculate_product_efficiency` = 1 or (`is_calculate_product_efficiency` = 1 and `project_predict_cost_setting_no` != '')) and `deal_appeal` in ('implantology', 'prosthesis') and exists (select * from `ord_order` where `ord_project`.`order_no` = `ord_order`.`order_no` and `begin_pay_date` >= '20240601' and `begin_pay_date` <= '20260301' and `bill_type` = 'ordinary' and `record_version_status` in ('current') and `record_effect_status` = 'effected' and `ord_order`.`deleted_at` is null) and `ord_project`.`deleted_at` is null) and `ord_project`.`deleted_at` is null group by `ord_project`.`counselor_adm_no`

        t.volume as volume,
        t.is_hold as is_hold,
        t.po_status as po_status,
        t.po_hour as po_hour,
        t.po_verify_datetime as po_verify_datetime,
        t.dw_update_datetime as dw_update_datetime,
        t.eda_datetime as eda_datetime,
        t.remark as remark,
        wo.plan_arrive_port_data as plan_arrive_port_data,
        wo.order_date as order_date,
        t.ISA_no as ISA_no,
        t.dw_update_user_name as dw_update_user_name,
        t.dw_update_count as dw_update_count,
        t.dw_update_err_reason as dw_update_err_reason,
        t.dw_update_status as dw_update_status,
        bfwe.expiry_days as expiry_days,
        t.isa_datetime as isa_datetime,
        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.edd_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '3'
        END
         as eddStatus,

        wo.return_date,
        wo.pick_up_date
        from wcp_order_dtl t
        inner JOIN wcp_order wo ON wo.id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sortation,
        order_id,
        MAX(appointment_plan_id) AS appointment_plan_id
        FROM wcp_appointment_plan_dtl
        GROUP BY sortation, order_id
        ) wapd ON wapd.sortation = t.sortation AND wapd.order_id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN wcp_appointment_plan wap ON wap.id = wapd.appointment_plan_id

select
        t.id as id,
        t.order_id as order_id,
        t.company_id as company_id,
        t.stat_id as stat_id,
        t.cust_id as cust_id,
        wo.cabin_no as cabin_no,
        wo.open_end_date as open_end_date,
        wo.oawb_no,
        wap.plan_no AS plan_no,
        t.is_dw AS is_dw,
        t.last_scan_code_str AS last_scan_code_str,
        t.last_scan_name_str AS last_scan_name_str,
        t.mark_no as mark_no,
        t.shipment_id as shipment_id,
        t.reference_id as reference_id,
        t.fba_stat_id as fba_stat_id,
        t.fba_stat_no as fba_stat_no,
        t.sortation as sortation,
        t.dw_datetime_start as dw_datetime_start,
        t.dw_datetime_end as dw_datetime_end,
        t.dw_datetime as dw_datetime,
        t.fba_station_status as fba_station_status,
        t.edd_datetime as edd_datetime,
        IFNULL(t.box_num, 0) as box_num,
        t.volume as volume,
        t.is_hold as is_hold,
        t.po_status as po_status,
        t.po_hour as po_hour,
        t.po_verify_datetime as po_verify_datetime,
        t.dw_update_datetime as dw_update_datetime,
        t.eda_datetime as eda_datetime,
        t.remark as remark,
        wo.plan_arrive_port_data as plan_arrive_port_data,
        wo.order_date as order_date,
        t.ISA_no as ISA_no,
        t.dw_update_user_name as dw_update_user_name,
        t.dw_update_count as dw_update_count,
        t.dw_update_err_reason as dw_update_err_reason,
        t.dw_update_status as dw_update_status,
        bfwe.expiry_days as expiry_days,
        t.isa_datetime as isa_datetime,
        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.edd_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '3'
        END
         as eddStatus,
        woe.api_register_status,
        woe.api_register_message,
        woe.register_datetime,
        woe.discharge_datetime,
        woe.pickup_estimated_datetime,
        woe.can_pickup_datetime,
        woe.lfd_datetime,
        woe.can_pickup_status,
        woe.plan_arrive_port_data_api_count,
        woe.ata_datetime_api_count,
        woe.discharge_datetime_api_count,
        woe.pickup_estimated_datetime_api_count,
        woe.can_pickup_datetime_api_count,
        woe.lfd_datetime_api_count,
        woe.trajectory_final_sync_datetime,
        wo.return_date,
        wo.pick_up_date
        from wcp_order_dtl t
        inner JOIN wcp_order wo ON wo.id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sortation,
        order_id,
        MAX(appointment_plan_id) AS appointment_plan_id
        FROM wcp_appointment_plan_dtl
        GROUP BY sortation, order_id
        ) wapd ON wapd.sortation = t.sortation AND wapd.order_id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN wcp_appointment_plan wap ON wap.id = wapd.appointment_plan_id
        left join bas_fba_warehouse_expiry bfwe
        on bfwe.warehouse_no = t.fba_stat_no
        and bfwe.stat_id = 39
        and bfwe.isdel = 0
        LEFT JOIN wcp_order_ext woe ON woe.order_id = t.order_id AND woe.isdel = 0
        where t.isdel = 0
        and t.addr_type = 'FBA'
         
            and t.company_id = 4090
         
         
            and t.stat_id = 39
         
         
                 
                 
                    and wo.plan_arrive_port_data >= '2025-11-14 11:41:25.0' and wo.plan_arrive_port_data <= '2026-02-12 15:59:59.0'
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
         
         
            and wo.order_status != 'YQS'
         
         
            and t.dw_datetime_start IS NOT NULL
            and t.dw_datetime_start > CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )
            and t.is_dw = 1
            and t.mark_no IS NOT NULL
            and (
            t.mark_no LIKE '999%'
            OR t.mark_no LIKE '888%'
            )
         
         
         
         
         
         
          
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
     
             
         
                order by id asc LIMIT 1000

        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-05:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(

            '+08:00',
            '-05:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-05:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL

select
        t.id as id,
        t.order_id as order_id,
        t.company_id as company_id,
        t.stat_id as stat_id,
        t.cust_id as cust_id,
        wo.cabin_no as cabin_no,
        wo.open_end_date as open_end_date,
        wo.oawb_no,
        wap.plan_no AS plan_no,
        t.is_dw AS is_dw,
        t.last_scan_code_str AS last_scan_code_str,
        t.last_scan_name_str AS last_scan_name_str,
        t.mark_no as mark_no,
        t.shipment_id as shipment_id,
        t.reference_id as reference_id,
        t.fba_stat_id as fba_stat_id,
        t.fba_stat_no as fba_stat_no,
        t.sortation as sortation,
        t.dw_datetime_start as dw_datetime_start,
        t.dw_datetime_end as dw_datetime_end,
        t.dw_datetime as dw_datetime,
        t.fba_station_status as fba_station_status,
        t.edd_datetime as edd_datetime,
        IFNULL(t.box_num, 0) as box_num,
        t.volume as volume,
        t.is_hold as is_hold,
        t.po_status as po_status,
        t.po_hour as po_hour,
        t.po_verify_datetime as po_verify_datetime,
        t.dw_update_datetime as dw_update_datetime,
        t.eda_datetime as eda_datetime,
        t.remark as remark,
        wo.plan_arrive_port_data as plan_arrive_port_data,
        wo.order_date as order_date,
        t.ISA_no as ISA_no,
        t.dw_update_user_name as dw_update_user_name,
        t.dw_update_count as dw_update_count,
        t.dw_update_err_reason as dw_update_err_reason,
        t.dw_update_status as dw_update_status,
        bfwe.expiry_days as expiry_days,
        t.isa_datetime as isa_datetime,
        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.edd_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '3'
        END
         as eddStatus,
        woe.api_register_status,
        woe.api_register_message,
        woe.register_datetime,
        woe.discharge_datetime,
        woe.pickup_estimated_datetime,
        woe.can_pickup_datetime,
        woe.lfd_datetime,
        woe.can_pickup_status,
        woe.plan_arrive_port_data_api_count,
        woe.ata_datetime_api_count,
        woe.discharge_datetime_api_count,
        woe.pickup_estimated_datetime_api_count,
        woe.can_pickup_datetime_api_count,
        woe.lfd_datetime_api_count,
        woe.trajectory_final_sync_datetime,
        wo.return_date,
        wo.pick_up_date
        from wcp_order_dtl t
        inner JOIN wcp_order wo ON wo.id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sortation,
        order_id,
        MAX(appointment_plan_id) AS appointment_plan_id
        FROM wcp_appointment_plan_dtl
        GROUP BY sortation, order_id
        ) wapd ON wapd.sortation = t.sortation AND wapd.order_id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN wcp_appointment_plan wap ON wap.id = wapd.appointment_plan_id
        left join bas_fba_warehouse_expiry bfwe
        on bfwe.warehouse_no = t.fba_stat_no

        t.dw_update_err_reason as dw_update_err_reason,
        t.dw_update_status as dw_update_status,
        bfwe.expiry_days as expiry_days,
        t.isa_datetime as isa_datetime,
        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-05:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-05:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-05:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.edd_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-05:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '3'
        END

        IFNULL(t.box_num, 0) as box_num,
        t.volume as volume,
        t.is_hold as is_hold,
        t.po_status as po_status,
        t.po_hour as po_hour,
        t.po_verify_datetime as po_verify_datetime,
        t.dw_update_datetime as dw_update_datetime,
        t.eda_datetime as eda_datetime,
        t.remark as remark,
        wo.plan_arrive_port_data as plan_arrive_port_data,
        wo.order_date as order_date,
        t.ISA_no as ISA_no,
        t.dw_update_user_name as dw_update_user_name,
        t.dw_update_count as dw_update_count,
        t.dw_update_err_reason as dw_update_err_reason,
        t.dw_update_status as dw_update_status,
        bfwe.expiry_days as expiry_days,
        t.isa_datetime as isa_datetime,
        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.edd_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '3'
        END

        wo.return_date,
        wo.pick_up_date
        from wcp_order_dtl t
        inner JOIN wcp_order wo ON wo.id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sortation,
        order_id,
        MAX(appointment_plan_id) AS appointment_plan_id
        FROM wcp_appointment_plan_dtl
        GROUP BY sortation, order_id
        ) wapd ON wapd.sortation = t.sortation AND wapd.order_id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN wcp_appointment_plan wap ON wap.id = wapd.appointment_plan_id

    P.ID_ ,

    SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 )) AS AMOUNT,
    IFNULL(CP.RATE,0) AS RATIO,
    SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 ))* IFNULL(CP.RATE,0)/100 AS R_AMOUNT,
    SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 ))-SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 ))*IFNULL(CP.RATE,0)/100 AS L_AMOUNT,
    case H.CASHWAY when '1' then '自收银' when '2' then '统一收银' when '3' then '代收银' end cashway

    LEFT JOIN ERP_SALE_REC_PAY A ON(A.POS_NO=B.POS_NO AND A.REC_ID=B.REC_ID)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_PERSON_DEF D ON(B.CASHIER_ID=D.ID_)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_CONTRACT_SHOP S ON (D.SHOPID=S.ID_)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_CONTRACT H ON (  S.REF_ID_ = H.ID_ )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_TENANT T ON(H.TENANT= T.CODE)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_PAYTYPE P ON ( A.PAYMENT_ID = P.ID_ )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_CONTRACT_PAYMENT CP ON(CP.REF_ID_ =H.ID_ AND CP.STARTDATE<= B.BOOK_DATE AND B.BOOK_DATE <= CP.ENDDATE AND P.PAYGROUP=CP.PAYGROUP )

SELECT
         
                (SELECT name FROM bd_course_type WHERE id = t.course_type_id) as courseType
             
        ,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) as value
        FROM (
        select
        sst.amount,
        tp.type as product_type_id,
        ps.course_type_id as course_type_id
        FROM
        pc_class_times pct
        INNER JOIN sc_student_times sst on pct.num = sst.times_num and pct.class_id = sst.class_id and sst.deleted = 0
        LEFT JOIN pc_class pc ON pc.id = pct.class_id
        LEFT JOIN pc_course ps ON pc.course_id = ps.id
        LEFT JOIN trade_product tp ON ps.product_id = tp.id
        LEFT JOIN trade_order_item toi ON sst.trace_id = toi.trace_id
        LEFT JOIN trade_order oi ON toi.order_id = oi.id
        LEFT JOIN bc_instructor_campus_ref ic
        ON ic.user_id = oi.sign_order_user_id
        AND ic.deleted = 0
        AND oi.sign_order_time >= ic.effective_start_time
        AND (ic.effective_end_time IS NULL OR oi.sign_order_time  <  ic.effective_end_time)
        WHERE
        pct.deleted = 0
        and sst.trade_status in (2, 4)
         
            and pc.business_id IN
             (  
                209
             ) 
         
         
            and ps.course_type_id = 3
         
         
            and tp.type = 'course'
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
             
                    AND ic.campus_id IN
                     (  
                        10
                     ) 
                 
         
        and pct.begin_time BETWEEN '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-02-27 23:59:59'
        ) t
         
                GROUP BY
                t.course_type_id

SELECT
aa.*, bb.canbaojins
FROM
(
	SELECT
	a.month,a.create_user,
	-- 根据billtype决定使用哪个城市ID
	CASE 
		WHEN a.billtype IN (1, 3) THEN a.city_id
		WHEN a.billtype = 2 THEN a.sc_city_id
		ELSE 0
	END as 'city_id',
    a.customer_id,a.company_id,
    -- GROUP_CONCAT(a.id),GROUP_CONCAT(a.billtype),count(a.billtype),
	-- e.name as '服务主体',
	-- '' as s11, 
	 e.short_name as '主体',
	'' as s12, -- max(cc.`name`) as cname,
	-- b.name as '客户名称',
	d.realname as '客服',
	b.short_name as '客户简称',
	-- 根据billtype决定使用哪个城市名称
	CASE 
		WHEN a.billtype IN (1, 3) THEN c1.name
		WHEN a.billtype = 2 THEN c2.name
		ELSE '未知'
	END as '城市',
	'' as s1,
	g.name as '产品',
	'' as s2,
	FROM_UNIXTIME(a.`month`,'%Y-%m'),
	a.service_price,
	count(DISTINCT a.person_card_code) as '人数',
	a.service_price as s13,
	'' as s3,
	sum(a.canbaojin) as '残疾人保障金收入',
	'' as s4,
	'' as s5,
	sum(a.service_price) as '服务费收入',
	-- GROUP_CONCAT(a.id),
	-- GROUP_CONCAT(a.service_price),
	'' as s6,
	'' as s7,
	'' as s8,
	'' as s9,
	-- sum(a.cost) as '供应商支出',
	SUM(if((f.is_supplier = 2 AND a.billtype = 1) or (f2.is_supplier = 2 AND a.billtype = 2),a.cost,0)) as '供应商支出',
	sum(a.service_price) - SUM(if((f.is_supplier = 2 AND a.billtype = 1) or (f2.is_supplier = 2 AND a.billtype = 2),a.cost,0)),
	if (f.is_supplier=1,'自营','供应商') as '是否自营',
	-- f.name as '供应商',
	-- if (a.billtype=1,f.name, if (a.billtype=2,f2.name,e.name)) as '供应商',
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.short_name) as '供应商',
	GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f2.short_name) as '发放主体',
	FROM_UNIXTIME(b.`create_time`,'%Y-%m'),
	'' as '备注'
	-- GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.person_card_code) as '人员'
	-- GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.short_name),
	-- GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f2.short_name)
	from evt_bill_list a
	LEFT JOIN evt_company e on (a.company_id=e.id)
	LEFT JOIN evt_product g on (a.product_id=g.id)
	LEFT JOIN evt_customer b on (a.customer_id=b.id)
	-- 根据billtype关联不同的城市
	LEFT JOIN evt_city c1 on (a.billtype IN (1, 3) AND a.city_id = c1.id)
	LEFT JOIN evt_city c2 on (a.billtype = 2 AND a.sc_city_id = c2.id)
	LEFT JOIN evt_user d on (a.create_user=d.id)
	LEFT JOIN evt_supplier f on (a.supplier_id=f.id)
	LEFT JOIN evt_grantcom f2 on (a.grantcom_id=f2.id)
	-- LEFT JOIN evt_contract as cc on cc.customer_id = a.customer_id AND cc.mark = 1 AND cc.type = 1 AND cc.`status` IN (3,4,5)
	WHERE 1=1
	AND a.`month` >= 1767196800 AND a.`month` <= 1769788800
	AND a.`status` not in (99) -- 11,
-- 	AND ((f.is_supplier = 2 AND a.billtype = 1) or (f2.is_supplier = 2 AND a.billtype = 2))
	and a.mark=1 
	AND a.bill_id > 0
-- 	AND a.customer_id IN (106749)
-- 	AND a.city_id = 179
-- 	AND a.id = 1936126
-- 	AND a.billtype = 1
	AND a.create_user > 0 
-- 	AND a.city_id > 0 
	AND a.customer_id > 0 -- AND a.company_id > 0 
	-- AND a.create_user = 356 AND a.customer_id = 95440
	GROUP BY a.create_user,
    -- 使用计算出的city_id进行分组
    CASE 
        WHEN a.billtype IN (1, 3) THEN a.city_id
        WHEN a.billtype = 2 THEN a.sc_city_id
        ELSE 0
    END,
    a.customer_id,a.month,a.company_id
	ORDER BY a.`month` desc, a.create_user desc, a.customer_id desc
	-- LIMIT 1
) as aa 
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
	month,server_user,city_id,customer_id,SUM(canbaojin) as canbaojins
	FROM
	evt_social_account_month
	WHERE
	mark = 1 AND server_user > 0 AND city_id > 0 AND customer_id > 0
	AND `month` >= 1767196800 AND `month` <= 1769788800
	GROUP BY server_user,city_id,customer_id,month
-- 	LIMIT 100
) as bb on bb.server_user = aa.create_user AND bb.customer_id = aa.customer_id AND bb.city_id = aa.city_id and bb.`month` = aa.`month`
GROUP BY aa.create_user,aa.city_id,aa.customer_id,aa.month,aa.company_id

    and psl.period_name = DATE_FORMAT(imph.accounting_date, '%Y-%m') and psl.period_status = 'CLOSED' and psl.period_closed_date is not null and NOW() >= psl.period_closed_date
  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_order_line impl ON imph.imp_order_id = impl.imp_order_id
  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_book_inventory impi ON imph.company_group_id = impi.company_group_id
  AND imph.dc_id = impi.dc_id
  AND LEFT(imph.year_month_date, 7) = CONCAT(impi.year, '-', LPAD(impi.month, 2, '0'))

  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_inventory_wd_header wh ON imph.company_group_id = wh.company_group_id

  LEFT JOIN hscs_hspm.hspm_party_merchant hpm ON imph.settlement_id = hpm.merchant_number AND imph.document_type IN ('70', '71', '80')
  LEFT JOIN hscs_hspm.hspm_party_merchant hpm1 ON imph.COMPANY_ID = hpm1.merchant_number AND imph.document_type IN ('75', '76', '86', '83', '84')

)

select
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status in ( '0','1','2','3','4','11','8') or tm.order_state = 9 then 1 else 0 end)   total,
        sum(case when tm.receipt_state = '1' and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)  waitWarehouse,
        sum(case when (tm.receipt_pcs   <=   0 or tm.receipt_pcs is null) and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)   waitReceipt,
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status = '1' and tm.receipt_state = '4' and tm.receipt_pcs is not null and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)   waitReceipting,
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status in ('4','1') and tm.receipt_state = '6' and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)   waitDateConfirm,
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status = '2' and tm.receipt_state = '7' and audit_state = '1' and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)  dateConfirm,
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status in ('4','1') and tm.receipt_state = '5' and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)  retested,
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status = '3' and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)   outCount,
        sum(case when tm.loading_cabinet_status in ('5') and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) then 1 else 0 end)  warehouseCount,
        sum(case when tm.manifest_status = '2' and tm.receipt_state = '7' and audit_state = '3'  then 1 else 0 end)   waitOutCount,
        count((select manifest_id from tms_manifest_pcs pcs where tm.id = pcs.manifest_id and pcs.isdel=0 and tm.manifest_status!='3' group by manifest_id having sum(pcs.parcels_pcs)>=count(pcs.id))) unGoodsCount,
        sum( CASE WHEN tm.manifest_status = '8' and (tm.order_state !='9' or tm.order_state is null) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) returnCount,

        left join tms_manifest_ext tme on tm.id = tme.manifest_id and tm.isdel = 0

left join yw_org_company oo on oo.org_id = so.purchase_org_id
left join aa_cost ac on ac.配送仓 = o.org_name and ac.门店 = oo.org_name
where so.is_del = 0

    and so.total_price > 0

    select 
        case_id,
        case 
            when max(case when connection_type = 11 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 11  -- 触达本人(最高优先级)
            when max(case when connection_type = 13 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 13  -- 非本人
            when max(case when connection_type = 12 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 12  -- 语音助手
            when max(case when connection_type = 14 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 14  -- 秒挂
        end as connected_status
    from case_media_summary
    where is_del = 0
    group by case_id
) cms_status on cms_status.case_id = e.id where e.is_del >= 0   AND (su.id = 868 )  and (cep.case_id is null or cep.timeout_return = 1)  and e.media_user_id = 868  and e.media_status = 100 and e.dept_id = 261  and e.media_user_id = 868  and (exists (
    select 1 from case_media_record cmr
    where cmr.case_id = e.id 
      and cmr.is_del = 0 
      and cmr.action_type = '智能体外呼'
      and cmr.contact_rst = 20
    limit 1
))  group by e.id  order by e.id desc  limit 0, 10

imph.complete_flag,

impl.imp_order_line_id,
impl.line_number,
impl.item_id,

impl.item_name,
wl.write_down_amount,
impi.sales_cost,
impi.final_avg_cost,
hpm.raw_material_supplier_id,
hpm1.attribute2,
hpm1.merchant_attribute,
case 
when imph.document_type IN ('70', '71', '80')
then hpm.sales_type
when imph.document_type IN ('75', '76', '86', '83', '84')
then hpm1.sales_type
end as sales_type
FROM
  iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_order imph
  JOIN hscs_hspm.hspm_period_status_lines psl on psl.source_system = 'IMP' and psl.company_code = imph.company_code 
    and psl.system_operation_name = '物流换月'
    and psl.imp_department_name = (case imph.company_group_id when '01' then '商品部' when '02' then '市场部' else '无效' end)
    and psl.period_name = DATE_FORMAT(imph.accounting_date, '%Y-%m') and psl.period_status = 'CLOSED' and psl.period_closed_date is not null and NOW() >= psl.period_closed_date
  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_order_line impl ON imph.imp_order_id = impl.imp_order_id
  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_book_inventory impi ON imph.company_group_id = impi.company_group_id
  AND imph.dc_id = impi.dc_id
  AND LEFT(imph.year_month_date, 7) = CONCAT(impi.year, '-', LPAD(impi.month, 2, '0'))
  AND impl.item_id = impi.item_id
  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_inventory_wd_header wh ON imph.company_group_id = wh.company_group_id
  AND imph.dc_id = wh.dc_id
  AND LEFT(imph.year_month_date, 7) = CONCAT(wh.`year`, '-', LPAD(wh.`month`, 2, '0'))
  LEFT JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_inventory_wd_line wl ON wh.inventory_wd_header_id = wl.inventory_wd_header_id
  AND impl.item_id = wl.item_id
  LEFT JOIN hscs_hspm.hspm_party_merchant hpm ON imph.settlement_id = hpm.merchant_number AND imph.document_type IN ('70', '71', '80')
  LEFT JOIN hscs_hspm.hspm_party_merchant hpm1 ON imph.COMPANY_ID = hpm1.merchant_number AND imph.document_type IN ('75', '76', '86', '83', '84')
WHERE 
--  imph.accounting_status = 'NEW'
-- AND 
imph.batch_number IN (
    SELECT batch_number
    FROM iscs_hsbm.lsbm_imp_order
    GROUP BY batch_number
    HAVING COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN complete_flag = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
)

SELECT t.* FROM (select
    so.stock_out_id                 as bill_id,
    so.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    sod.out_stock_detail_id         as bill_detail_id,
    so.bill_type                    as bill_type,
    so.bill_date                    as bill_date,
    so.account_date                 as bill_create_time,
    so.bussiness_date               as bill_stock_time,
    so.audit_date                   as bill_audit_time,
    'out'                           as stock_type,
    so.purchase_org_id              as in_org_id,               -- 出货组织
    so.sale_org_id                  as out_org_id,              -- 出货组织
    null                            as supplier_id,
    sod.material_id                 as material_id,
    ma.third_material_id            as third_material_id,
    ma.material_name                as material_name,
    ma.material_type_id             as material_type_id,
    mt.material_type_name           as material_type_name,
    sod.material_desc               as material_desc,
    sod.stock_out_unit_id           as stock_unit_name,
    sod.send_num                    as num,
    IFNULL(sod.price,0)             as price,
    sod.amount                      as amount,
    IFNULL(sod.no_tax_out_amount,0) as no_tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sod.tax,0)               as tax,
    IFNULL(sod.tax_out_amount,0)    as tax_amount,
    ROUND(ifnull(sod.tax, 0) * sod.no_tax_out_amount, 4) as warning_tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sod.net_weight, 0)       as net_weight,
    IFNULL(sod.total_weight, 0)     as total_weight,
    sc.num                          as check_num,
    sc.price                        as check_price,
    sc.amount                       as check_amount,
    sc.no_tax_amount                as check_no_tax_amount,
    sc.tax                          as check_tax,
    sc.tax_amount                   as check_tax_amount,
    sc.net_weight                   as check_net_weight,
    sc.total_weight                 as check_total_weight
from scm_stock_out_detail_rela sod
inner join scm_stock_out_rela so on sod.stock_out_id = so.stock_out_id and sod.app_id = so.app_id
left join base_material_rela ma on sod.material_id = ma.material_id and sod.app_id = ma.app_id
left join base_material_type_rela mt on ma.material_type_id = mt.material_type_id and sod.app_id = mt.app_id
left join yw_stock_bill_detail_check sc on so.bill_type = sc.bill_type and sod.out_stock_detail_id = sc.bill_detail_id and so.stock_out_id = sc.bill_id and sc.is_del = 0
where so.is_del = 0
    and sod.is_del = 0
    and so.bill_status = 'ysh'
    and COALESCE(so.syscomment, '') not like '%KD%'
and (ROUND(ifnull(sod.tax, 0) * sod.no_tax_out_amount, 4) != sod.tax_out_amount)
and so.bill_type = 'psck'
and (so.audit_date >= '2026-02-01 00:00:00' and so.audit_date <= '2026-02-28 23:59:59')
) t order by t.bill_audit_time desc 
 limit 0, 50

		gift.name AS "gift.name",
		gift.price AS "gift.price",
		gift.img AS "gift.img",
		gift.texiao AS "gift.texiao",

		memberChongzhiRecord.is_super_value AS "memberChongzhiRecord.isSuperValue",
		memberChongzhiRecord.paytype AS "memberChongzhiRecord.paytype",

		t.aidousum AS aidousum

		SELECT
		a.member_id,
		SUM(a.aidou) AS aidousum,
		MAX(a.id) AS last_record_id
		FROM t_member_aidou_record a
		INNER JOIN t_member m ON m.id = a.member_id

			AND m.state = '1'

		GROUP BY a.member_id
		ORDER BY aidousum DESC
		LIMIT 30
		) AS t
		JOIN t_member_aidou_record a_detail ON a_detail.id = t.last_record_id
		JOIN t_member member ON member.id = t.member_id
		LEFT JOIN t_member other ON other.id = a_detail.otherid
		LEFT JOIN t_gift gift ON gift.id = a_detail.giftid

		LEFT JOIN t_member_nobel nobel ON nobel.member_id = a_detail.member_id

/* ApplicationName=DataGrip 2025.3.5 */ select
    so.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    ma.material_name                as material_name,
    IFNULL(sod.amount,0)            as amount,
    IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)       as cost_amount,
    ROUND(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)/(1+IFNULL(mr.deductible_rate,0)),2)       as 成本合计多链,
    ROUND(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)/(1+IFNULL(mr.deductible_rate,0)),2)-ac.成本未含税金额 as 成本差异,
    ac.成本未含税金额,
    mr.sale_rate                    as out_rate,
    mr.deductible_rate              as in_rate
from scm_stock_out_detail_rela sod
inner join scm_stock_out_rela so on sod.stock_out_id = so.stock_out_id and sod.app_id = so.app_id
left join base_material_rela ma on sod.material_id = ma.material_id and ma.app_id = sod.app_id
left join base_material_type_rela mat on ma.material_type_id = mat.material_type_id and mat.app_id = sod.app_id
left join yw_material_rate mr on ma.material_id = mr.material_id
left join yw_org_company o on o.org_id = so.sale_org_id
left join yw_org_company oo on oo.org_id = so.purchase_org_id
right join aa_cost_detail ac on o.org_name = ac.supplier_name and oo.org_name = ac.org_name and ma.material_name = ac.货品名称 and ac.单号 = so.bill_no
where so.is_del = 0
    and sod.is_del = 0
    and so.total_price > 0
    and COALESCE(so.syscomment, '') NOT LIKE '%KD%'
and so.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and so.bill_type in ('psck')
and (so.audit_date between '2026-02-01T00:00' and '2026-02-28T23:59:59')
and so.sale_org_id = '101305873741119723'
and so.bill_status = 'ysh'
and so.purchase_org_id NOT IN (select
        o.org_id
    from yw_org_company o
    where o.is_del = 0 and o.third_company_id in (select b.third_company_id from yw_org_company b where b.org_id = so.sale_org_id)
    and o.org_id != so.sale_org_id and (o.is_independent_settlement = 1 or o.org_type = 3))

select * from (
SELECT
concat( H.MALL,H.TENANT,B.BOOK_DATE ) as id,
'1' CREATE_BY_,
    H.MALL ,
    D.SHOP_NAME ,
    A.REC_ID ,
    H.TENANT ,
    H.TENANT_NAME ,
    B.BOOK_DATE,
    A.POS_NO,
    H.CONTRACTNO,
    P.`NAME`,
    P.ID_ ,
    S.CATEGORY_NAME,
    SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 )) AS AMOUNT,
    IFNULL(CP.RATE,0) AS RATIO,
    SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 ))* IFNULL(CP.RATE,0)/100 AS R_AMOUNT,
    SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 ))-SUM(IFNULL( A.AMOUNT, 0 ))*IFNULL(CP.RATE,0)/100 AS L_AMOUNT,
    case H.CASHWAY when '1' then '自收银' when '2' then '统一收银' when '3' then '代收银' end cashway 
    FROM ERP_SALE_REC B
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SALE_REC_PAY A ON(A.POS_NO=B.POS_NO AND A.REC_ID=B.REC_ID)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_PERSON_DEF D ON(B.CASHIER_ID=D.ID_)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_CONTRACT_SHOP S ON (D.SHOPID=S.ID_)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_CONTRACT H ON (  S.REF_ID_ = H.ID_ )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_TENANT T ON(H.TENANT= T.CODE)
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_PAYTYPE P ON ( A.PAYMENT_ID = P.ID_ )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_CONTRACT_PAYMENT CP ON(CP.REF_ID_ =H.ID_ AND CP.STARTDATE<= B.BOOK_DATE AND B.BOOK_DATE <= CP.ENDDATE AND P.PAYGROUP=CP.PAYGROUP )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_CATEGORY C1 ON ( S.CATEGORY = C1.CODE )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_CATEGORY C2 ON ( C1.PARENT_ID_ = C2.ID_ )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_CATEGORY C3 ON ( C2.PARENT_ID_ = C3.ID_ )
    LEFT JOIN ERP_SYS_CATEGORY C4 ON ( C3.PARENT_ID_ = C4.ID_ ) WHERE P.APP_CODE LIKE 'SP%' 	GROUP BY H.MALL,H.TENANT,B.BOOK_DATE

 LIMIT 50, 50

        t.dw_update_datetime as dw_update_datetime,

        t.dw_update_user_name as dw_update_user_name,
        t.dw_update_count as dw_update_count,
        t.dw_update_err_reason as dw_update_err_reason,
        t.dw_update_status as dw_update_status,
        bfwe.expiry_days as expiry_days,
        t.isa_datetime as isa_datetime,
        CASE
        WHEN  t.isa_datetime IS NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
        and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
        THEN '1'
        WHEN t.isa_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.isa_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '2'
        END
        as dwStatus,
        CASE
        WHEN t.edd_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND CONVERT_TZ(
        t.edd_datetime,
        '+08:00',
        '-08:00'
        ) NOT BETWEEN t.dw_datetime_start AND t.dw_datetime_end
        THEN '3'
        END
         as eddStatus,
        woe.api_register_status,
        woe.api_register_message,
        woe.register_datetime,
        woe.discharge_datetime,
        woe.pickup_estimated_datetime,
        woe.can_pickup_datetime,
        woe.lfd_datetime,
        woe.can_pickup_status,
        woe.plan_arrive_port_data_api_count,
        woe.ata_datetime_api_count,
        woe.discharge_datetime_api_count,
        woe.pickup_estimated_datetime_api_count,
        woe.can_pickup_datetime_api_count,
        woe.lfd_datetime_api_count,
        woe.trajectory_final_sync_datetime,
        wo.return_date,
        wo.pick_up_date
        from wcp_order_dtl t
        inner JOIN wcp_order wo ON wo.id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sortation,
        order_id,
        MAX(appointment_plan_id) AS appointment_plan_id
        FROM wcp_appointment_plan_dtl
        GROUP BY sortation, order_id
        ) wapd ON wapd.sortation = t.sortation AND wapd.order_id = t.order_id
        LEFT JOIN wcp_appointment_plan wap ON wap.id = wapd.appointment_plan_id
        left join bas_fba_warehouse_expiry bfwe
        on bfwe.warehouse_no = t.fba_stat_no
        and bfwe.stat_id = 39
        and bfwe.isdel = 0
        LEFT JOIN wcp_order_ext woe ON woe.order_id = t.order_id AND woe.isdel = 0
        where t.isdel = 0
        and t.addr_type = 'FBA'
         
            and t.company_id = 4090
         
         
            and t.stat_id = 39
         
         
                 
                 
                    and wo.plan_arrive_port_data >= '2025-11-14 14:56:58.0' and wo.plan_arrive_port_data <= '2026-02-12 15:59:59.0'
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
                 
         
         
            and wo.order_status != 'YQS'
         
         
            and t.dw_datetime_start IS NOT NULL
            and t.dw_datetime_start > CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )
            and t.is_dw = 1
            and t.mark_no IS NOT NULL
            and (
            t.mark_no LIKE '999%'
            OR t.mark_no LIKE '888%'
            )
         
         
         
            AND t.isa_datetime IS NULL
            AND CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            ) <= t.dw_datetime_start
            and  DATEDIFF(t.dw_datetime_start,CONVERT_TZ(
            IFNULL(NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
            '+08:00',
            '-08:00'
            )) <= bfwe.expiry_days 
         
         
         
         
          
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
            and t.fba_stat_id = 304
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
     
             
         
                order by id asc LIMIT 1000

/* ApplicationName=DataGrip 2025.3.5 */ select
    so.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    ma.material_name                as material_name,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.amount,0))            as amount,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0))       as cost_amount,
    sum(ROUND(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)/(1+IFNULL(mr.deductible_rate,0)),2))       as 成本合计多链,
    SUM(ROUND(tt.成本未含税金额,2)) as 成本未含税金额,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)/(1+IFNULL(mr.deductible_rate,0))-ROUND(tt.成本未含税金额,2)) as 成本差异,
    mr.sale_rate                    as out_rate,
    mr.deductible_rate              as in_rate
from scm_stock_out_detail_rela sod
inner join scm_stock_out_rela so on sod.stock_out_id = so.stock_out_id and sod.app_id = so.app_id
left join base_material_rela ma on sod.material_id = ma.material_id and ma.app_id = sod.app_id
left join base_material_type_rela mat on ma.material_type_id = mat.material_type_id and mat.app_id = sod.app_id
left join yw_material_rate mr on ma.material_id = mr.material_id
left join yw_org_company o on o.org_id = so.sale_org_id
left join yw_org_company oo on oo.org_id = so.purchase_org_id
right join (
    select sum(ROUND(IFNULL(ac.成本总金额,0)/(1+IFNULL(ac.成本税率,0)),2)) as 成本未含税金额, ac.货品ID as 货品ID, ac.单号, ac.org_name, ac.supplier_name from aa_cost_detail ac
                group by ac.货品ID, ac.org_name, ac.supplier_name, ac.单号
) tt on o.org_name = tt.supplier_name and oo.org_name = tt.org_name
                  and ma.third_material_id = tt.货品ID and tt.单号 = so.bill_no
where so.is_del = 0
    and sod.is_del = 0
    and so.total_price > 0
    and COALESCE(so.syscomment, '') NOT LIKE '%KD%'
and so.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and so.bill_type in ('psck')
and (so.audit_date between '2026-02-01T00:00' and '2026-02-28T23:59:59')
and so.sale_org_id = '101305873741119781'
and so.bill_status = 'ysh'
  and so.purchase_org_id = '101305873741119502'

	pc.course_type_id,
	bct.name courseTypeName,

	pc.subject_id,
	s.name subjectName

	left join pc_class_times ct on ct.class_id=st.class_id and ct.num=st.times_num
	left join pc_class c on c.id=ct.class_id
	left join pc_course pc on pc.id=c.course_id

	left join bd_campus bc on bc.id=m.campus_id
	left join bc_business b on b.id=c.business_id
	left join bd_course_type bct on bct.id=pc.course_type_id
	left join bd_grade g on g.id=c.grade_id
	left join bd_subject s on s.id=pc.subject_id
	 WHERE st.deleted=false and ct.deleted=false and st.trade_status != 3 and st.attend_status=1
	  
	  
	    and st.attend_time >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
	  
	  
	    and st.attend_time <= '2026-03-10 23:59:59' 
	group by business_id,campus_id,course_type_id,grade_id,subject_id
	union all
	select 
	c.business_id,

	m.campus_id,
	bc.name campusName,
	pc.course_type_id,
	bct.name courseTypeName,
	c.grade_id,
	g.name gradeName,
	pc.subject_id,
	s.name subjectName
	from pc_class_consume cc 
	left join pc_class_times ct on ct.class_id=cc.class_id and ct.num=cc.times_num
	left join pc_class c on c.id=ct.class_id
	left join pc_course pc on pc.id=c.course_id
	left join bd_classroom m on m.id=ct.classroom_id
	left join bd_campus bc on bc.id=m.campus_id

	left join bd_course_type bct on bct.id=pc.course_type_id
	left join bd_grade g on g.id=c.grade_id
	left join bd_subject s on s.id=pc.subject_id
	 WHERE cc.deleted=false and ct.deleted=false
	  
	  
	    and cc.create_time >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'

SELECT
		t5.NAME AS studentName,
		t5.number AS studentNumber,
		t6.NAME AS businessName,
		t2.NAME AS examName,
		(select name from bd_exam_type where id = t2.exam_type_id and deleted = 0)AS examTypeName,
		t7.NAME AS subjectName,
		t1.score AS score,
		t8.NAME AS gradeName,
		t9.NAME AS campusName,
		GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT t4.NAME ORDER BY t4.id ASC ) AS courseSystemName,
		GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT concat(t12.NAME,t13.NAME) ORDER BY t12.id,t13.id ASC ) AS courseSeriesClassTypeName,
		GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT t14.NAME ORDER BY t14.id ASC ) AS courseTypeItemName,
		t1.exam_date AS examDate,
		t10.nickname AS enterName,
		t1.create_time AS enterDate,
		t1.description,
		IF
	( unix_timestamp( t2.effective_date ) <  unix_timestamp( NOW()), '过期', '有效' ) AS STATUS ,
		t11.total_score as totalScore
	FROM
		rc_student_achievements_record t1
		LEFT JOIN pc_exam t2 ON t1.exam_id = t2.id
		LEFT JOIN rc_student_achievements_course_paradigm t3 ON t1.id = t3.achievements_id 
		AND t3.deleted = 0
		LEFT JOIN pc_course_system t4 ON t3.course_paradigm_id = t4.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_course_series t12 ON t3.course_series_id = t12.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_class_type t13 ON t3.class_type_id = t13.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_course_type_item t14 ON t3.course_type_item_id = t14.id
		LEFT JOIN rc_student t5 ON t5.id = t1.student_id
		LEFT JOIN bc_business t6 ON t1.business_id = t6.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_subject t7 ON t1.subject_id = t7.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_grade t8 ON t1.grade_id = t8.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_campus t9 ON t1.campus_id = t9.id
		LEFT JOIN uc_user t10 ON t1.create_uid = t10.id 
		LEFT JOIN pc_exam_grade_subject t11 ON t11.exam_id = t1.exam_id and t1.grade_id= t11.grade_id and  t1.subject_id = t11.subject_id and t11.deleted=0
	WHERE
		t1.deleted = 0 
          
                AND t1.business_id  IN
					 (  
						1
					 , 
						2
					 , 
						3
					 ) 
          
          
                AND t1.exam_date >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
          
          
                AND t1.exam_date <= '2026-02-22 23:59:59'
          
		  
	GROUP BY
		t1.id 
	ORDER BY
		t1.create_time DESC

        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.student_id) as consumeStudentNum,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.class_id, cc.times_num) as consumeTimesNum,
        SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (1, 2, 3), cc.class_consume_hour, 0)) - SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (6, 7 ,8), cc.class_consume_hour, 0)) - SUM(IF(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(1,2,3),cc.class_consume_hour, 0)) as classConsumeHour,
        SUM(IF(cc.consume_type IN (1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8), cc.class_consume_amount, 0)) + COALESCE(sum(if(cc.consume_type=11 AND cc.src_consume_type IN(1,2,3) ,cc.class_consume_amount,null)),0) as classConsumeAmount
        FROM
        (SELECT
        pcc.consume_type,
        pcc.class_consume_hour,
        pcc.student_id,
        pcc.class_id,
        pcc.times_num,
        pcc.class_consume_amount,
        src.consume_type as src_consume_type
        FROM pc_class_consume pcc
        LEFT JOIN pc_class_consume src ON src.record_id = pcc.source_record_id
         
        INNER JOIN pc_class pc ON pcc.class_id = pc.id
        INNER JOIN pc_course ps ON pc.course_id = ps.id
        INNER JOIN trade_product tp ON pc.product_id = tp.id
        LEFT JOIN bc_business bu ON bu.id = pc.business_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_campus cp ON cp.id = pc.campus_id
        LEFT JOIN pc_course_system cs ON ps.course_system_id = cs.id
        LEFT JOIN bd_class_year cy ON cy.id = ps.class_year_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_class_semester css ON css.id = ps.class_semester_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_grade bg ON bg.id = ps.grade_id
        LEFT JOIN bd_subject bs ON bs.id = ps.subject_id
        
        LEFT JOIN pc_class_times sa ON pcc.class_id = sa.class_id and pcc.times_num = sa.num
        left join bd_class_type bct on bct.id = ps.class_type_id
        left join bd_course_series bdcs on ps.course_series_id=bdcs.id
        left join bd_course_type_item bcti on bcti.id=ps.course_type_item_id
     
        WHERE
         
        pcc.deleted = 0

SELECT
            t1.dept_name AS dept_name,
            t1.main_dept_name AS main_dept_name,
            t1.invoice_push_time AS invoice_push_time,
            t1.customer_name AS customer_name,
            t1.agent_customer_name AS agent_customer_name,
            t1.invoicing_no AS invoicing_no,
            CASE
                t1.invoice_type
                WHEN '007' THEN
                    '纸质普票'
                WHEN '004' THEN
                    '纸质专票'
                WHEN '026' THEN
                    '电子普票'
                WHEN '028' THEN
                    '电子专票'
                END AS invoice_type,
            ( SELECT service_category FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id LIMIT 1 ) AS service_category,
            ( SELECT service_name FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id LIMIT 1 ) AS service_name,
            t1.actual_invoice_fee AS actual_invoice_fee,
            ( SELECT SUM( t2.amount_money ) - SUM( t2.tax_fee ) FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id ) AS no_tax_invoice_fee,
            ( SELECT SUM( t2.tax_fee ) FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id ) AS tax_invoice_fee,
            CASE
                t1.invoice_status
                WHEN 0 THEN
                '未开票'
                WHEN 1 THEN
                '已开票'
                WHEN 2 THEN
                '已作废' ELSE '未知状态'
                END AS invoice_status
            FROM
                tms_customer_invoice t1
        WHERE (t1.del_flag = '0' AND t1.customer_id = 1702218718021898242 AND t1.invoice_push_time BETWEEN '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-02-12 23:59:59' AND t1.dept_id IN (853932375)) ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC,t1.id DESC

SELECT 
    m.month_num AS `month`,
    COALESCE((
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM case_call_log 
        WHERE dail_status = 1 AND is_del = 0 AND call_type = 1
          AND dialing_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(@year, '-', LPAD(m.month_num, 2, '0'), '-01'))
          AND dialing_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(@year, '-', LPAD(m.month_num, 2, '0'), '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
    ), 0) AS call_connected
FROM (SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
      UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 
      UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12) m
ORDER BY m.month_num

select a.pro_code
, b. QJ as end_qj
, (a.QJ - b. QJ) as last_ql
, case when ifnull(a. QJ,0) = 0  then 0 else (a.QJ - b. QJ)/a. QJ  end as lsat_qlv
, (c.QJ - b. QJ) as ljql
,a.QJ 开始
,b.QJ 结束
from ( 
-- 开始日的欠缴金额
select 
pro_code,
SUM(QJ) AS QJ  from (
select pro_code,
sum(YS)/10000 as YS,
sum(TZ)/10000 as TZ,
sum(SS)/10000 AS SS,
sum(YS+TZ-SS)/10000 AS QJ
from TB_DM_ARREARS_KUAIZHAO
where 1=1
AND FileDate = '2025-01-01'
and pro_code in ('60058')
and ChargeTypename in ('1','2','3','4')
and PRO_DATE >='2025-01'
and PRO_DATE <='2025-12'
group by pro_code
) p GROUP BY pro_code ) a
left join 
-- 结束日的欠缴金额
(select 
pro_code,
SUM(QJ) AS QJ  from (
select pro_code,
sum(YS)/10000 as YS,
sum(TZ)/10000 as TZ,
sum(SS)/10000 AS SS,
sum(YS)/10000+sum(TZ)/10000-sum(SS)/10000 AS QJ
from TB_DM_ARREARS_KUAIZHAO
where FileDate = '2025-12-31'
and pro_code in ('60058')
and ChargeTypename in ('1','2','3','4')
and PRO_DATE >='2025-01'
and PRO_DATE <='2025-12'
group by pro_code
) p GROUP BY pro_code ) b
on a.pro_code=b.pro_code
left join 
-- 累计日欠缴欠缴金额
(select 
pro_code,
SUM(QJ) AS QJ  from (
select pro_code,
sum(YS)/10000 as YS,
sum(TZ)/10000 as TZ,
sum(SS)/10000 AS SS,
sum(YS)/10000+sum(TZ)/10000-sum(SS)/10000 AS QJ
from TB_DM_ARREARS_KUAIZHAO
where FileDate = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
and pro_code in ('60058')
and ChargeTypename in ('1','2','3','4')
and PRO_DATE >='2025-01'
and PRO_DATE <='2025-12'
group by pro_code
) p GROUP BY pro_code ) c
on a.pro_code=c.pro_code

SELECT
      关联公司范围,
      公司数量,
      占比,
      总数
  FROM (
      SELECT
          CASE
              WHEN related_company_count >= 1 AND related_company_count < 3 THEN '1-3家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 3 AND related_company_count < 5 THEN '3-5家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 5 AND related_company_count < 10 THEN '5-10家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 10 AND related_company_count < 20 THEN '10-20家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 20 THEN '20家及以上'
              ELSE '0家'
          END AS 关联公司范围,
          COUNT(*) AS 公司数量,
          CONCAT(
              ROUND(
                  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company WHERE recommend_level = 1 AND basic_dimensions_status = 1 AND is_abnormal = 0 AND not_match_status = 0 AND phone_status = 1),
                  2
              ),
              '%'
          ) AS 占比,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company WHERE recommend_level = 1 AND basic_dimensions_status = 1 AND is_abnormal = 0 AND not_match_status = 0 AND phone_status = 1) AS 总数
      FROM
          company
      WHERE
          recommend_level = 1
          AND basic_dimensions_status = 1
          AND is_abnormal = 0
          AND not_match_status = 0
          AND phone_status = 1
      GROUP BY
          CASE
              WHEN related_company_count >= 1 AND related_company_count < 3 THEN '1-3家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 3 AND related_company_count < 5 THEN '3-5家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 5 AND related_company_count < 10 THEN '5-10家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 10 AND related_company_count < 20 THEN '10-20家'
              WHEN related_company_count >= 20 THEN '20家及以上'
              ELSE '0家'
          END
  ) AS subquery
  ORDER BY
      FIELD(关联公司范围, '0家', '1-3家', '3-5家', '5-10家', '10-20家', '20家及以上')

             AND cbt.create_date < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(@year, 1), INTERVAL m.month_num MONTH)
        WHERE ce.is_del = 0 
          AND ce.media_no_self != ''
          AND (
              (ce.media_status = 300 
               AND ce.settle_time >= MAKEDATE(@year, 1) 
               AND ce.settle_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(@year, 1), INTERVAL m.month_num MONTH))
              OR cbt.id IS NOT NULL
          )
    ) AS success_count_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
    UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 
    UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12
) m
ORDER BY m.month_num

select * from (
SELECT *
FROM (
			SELECT A.PRO_CODE -- 项目编码
						,A.CONTRACTSID -- 合同编号
						,B.CONTRACTSID AS LAST_CONTRACTSID
						,A.RentArea -- 租赁面积
						,A.CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
						,B.ConStopDate -- 合同提前终止时间
						,A.ModifyTime
						,A.UnitTypeCode
						,A.UNITID
						,A.BrandID
						,A.BrandName
						,A.TradeRelationName1
            ,'2025-11' AS FileDate
						,TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE ) AS DIFF -- 日期相差天数
						-- 如果相差天数>=1 或者没有上一份合同的话就判断为新引
						-- 如果相差天数<0 也就是说上一份合同合同还没有到结束时间 新合同就开始了
						,CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE) > 1 THEN '新引'
									WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,B.ConStopDate,A.CONSTARTDATE) IS NULL THEN '新引'
									ELSE '汰换' END LABLE
			FROM (

						SELECT CONTRACTSID -- 合同id
									,PRO_CODE
									,RentArea
									,UNITID -- 铺位id
									,UnitTypeCode
									,BrandID
									,BrandName
									,TradeRelationName1
									,CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
									,CONENDDATE -- 合同结束时间
									,ModifyTime
						FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO
						WHERE BIZMODE = 1 -- 筛选铺位类型为租赁
									-- AND CONTRACTSSTATUS = 3 -- 筛选合同状态为进行中
									AND CONTRACTSSTATUS not in (1,2,10)
									and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2025-11','-01'),interval 1 month),7)
						) A
				
						LEFT JOIN 
						
						(
			-- 筛选每个项目除现正在执行中的合同,然后查出每个铺位最早开始的合同
			SELECT CONTRACTSID -- 合同id
						,UNITID -- 铺位id
						,CONSTARTDATE -- 合同开始时间
						,CONENDDATE -- 合同结束时间
						,MAX(ConStopDate) ConStopDate-- 合同提前结束时间
			FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO A
			WHERE BIZMODE = 1 -- 晒选铺位类型为租赁
						AND CONTRACTSSTATUS != 3 -- 筛选合同状态不为进行中
						and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2025-11','-01'),interval 1 month),7)
						AND 1 = (SELECT COUNT(1) -- 筛选最大开始时间的合同
										 FROM (SELECT CONTRACTSID
																	,UNITID
																	,ConStartDate
																	,CONENDDATE
																	,CONTRACTSSTATUS
														FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_FY_KUAIZHAO
														WHERE BIZMODE = 1
																	AND CONTRACTSSTATUS NOT IN (1,2,10)
																	AND CONTRACTSSTATUS != 3 -- 筛选合同状态不为进行中
																	and left(FileDate,7) = left(ADDDATE(CONCAT('2025-11','-01'),interval 1 month),7)	) B 
											WHERE A.UNITID = B.UNITID AND A.ConStartDate <= B.ConStartDate)
			GROUP BY UNITID 
						) B ON A.UNITID = B.UNITID
WHERE 1=1

)A
WHERE CONTRACTSID in (

)

SELECT dates, MAX(orderCount) AS payOrderCount,MAX(payActualTotal) as payActualTotal,MAX(payActualTotalScore) as payActualTotalScore FROM(
        SELECT @cdate := DATE_ADD(@cdate,INTERVAL - 1 DAY) dates ,0 AS 'orderCount',0 AS 'payActualTotal',0 as 'payActualTotalScore'
        FROM (SELECT @cdate :=DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL + 1 DAY) FROM tz_user) t1
         WHERE  @cdate >= '2026-01-27 23:59:59.999' 
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dates,COUNT(*) AS orderCount,
            SUM(actual_total) AS payActualTotal,
            SUM(ifnull(o.actual_total_score,0)) AS payActualTotalScore
        FROM tz_order o
         WHERE  o.shop_id = 1
            
            
                and o.pay_time >= '2026-01-27 23:59:59.999'
            
            
                and o.pay_time <= '2026-02-27 23:59:59.999'
            
            AND o.is_payed =1 
        GROUP BY dates) _tmpAllTable  GROUP BY dates
        ORDER BY dates
