SELECT
            t1.dept_name AS dept_name,
            t1.main_dept_name AS main_dept_name,
            t1.invoice_push_time AS invoice_push_time,
            t1.customer_name AS customer_name,
            t1.agent_customer_name AS agent_customer_name,
            t1.invoicing_no AS invoicing_no,
            CASE
                t1.invoice_type
                WHEN '007' THEN
                    '纸质普票'
                WHEN '004' THEN
                    '纸质专票'
                WHEN '026' THEN
                    '电子普票'
                WHEN '028' THEN
                    '电子专票'
                END AS invoice_type,
            ( SELECT service_category FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id LIMIT 1 ) AS service_category,
            ( SELECT service_name FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id LIMIT 1 ) AS service_name,
            t1.actual_invoice_fee AS actual_invoice_fee,
            ( SELECT SUM( t2.amount_money ) - SUM( t2.tax_fee ) FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id ) AS no_tax_invoice_fee,
            ( SELECT SUM( t2.tax_fee ) FROM tms_customer_invoice_flow t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.customer_invoice_id ) AS tax_invoice_fee,
            CASE
                t1.invoice_status
                WHEN 0 THEN
                '未开票'
                WHEN 1 THEN
                '已开票'
                WHEN 2 THEN
                '已作废' ELSE '未知状态'
                END AS invoice_status
            FROM
                tms_customer_invoice t1
        WHERE (t1.del_flag = '0' AND t1.check_status = 2 AND t1.invoice_status IN (1) AND t1.operate_type = 1 AND t1.invoice_push_time BETWEEN '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-02-28 23:59:59') ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC,t1.id DESC

select count(1)  from ( select
	main.etp_sup_ou_code '供应商编码',
  max(org.etp_name) '供应商',
	CONCAT(max(org.province_name),'/',max(org.city_name),'/',max(org.area_name)) '所在区域',
	sum(case when number > 0 then 1 else 0 end) '订单笔数',
	sum(number) '销售数量',
	ROUND(sum(settle_amount), 2) '结算金额',
	ROUND(sum(pay_amount), 2) '销售金额',
	ROUND(sum(pay_amount), 2) '分销金额',
	ROUND(sum(cost_amount), 2) '销售成本',
	ROUND(sum(service_charge), 2) '退款手续费',
	ROUND(sum(pay_amount) - sum(cost_amount), 2) '销售利润',
	CONCAT(ROUND((sum(pay_amount) - sum(cost_amount))/sum(cost_amount)*100, 2),'%') '总利润率'
from 
 (
select 
	a.*, IFNULL(b.ou_code, '0') ou_code
from 
(

select 
SUBSTRING(etp_sup_ou_code, 1, 7) etp_sup_ou_code,
order_mode,
trade_no,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(number, 0) else 0 end) number,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) else 0 end) pay_amount,
sum(IFNULL(settle_amount, 0)) settle_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(cost_amount, 0) else 0 end) cost_amount,
sum(IFNULL(refund_number,0)) refund_number,
sum(IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) refund_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) > 0) then (IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) - IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) else 0 end) service_charge
from ord_shopping_order_item_detail 
where 1=1 
and etp_sup_ou_code like '2%'
and order_type in ('200017001', '200024001')
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
and  Date(checkin_time)     between '2026-02-26 00:00:00' and '2026-02-26 23:59:59'

SELECT
			s.id,
			s.settlement_date,
			s.`status`,
			IF(
				s.`status` = 3,
				(
					SELECT IFNULL( SUM( r.amount ), 0 ) 
					FROM trade_daily_settlement_receipt r
					WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.daily_settlement_id = s.id
				),
				(
					SELECT
						IFNULL( SUM( p.payment_amount ), 0 ) AS amount
					FROM
						trade_order o
						LEFT JOIN trade_order_payment p ON p.order_id = o.id
					WHERE
						p.deleted = 0
						AND o.order_status = 1 
						AND DATE_FORMAT( o.pay_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = s.settlement_date
				) 
			) AS receipt_total,
			IF(
				s.`status` = 3,
				(
					SELECT
						IFNULL( SUM( r.amount ), 0 )
					FROM trade_daily_settlement_refund r 
					WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.daily_settlement_id = s.id
				),
				(
					SELECT
						IFNULL( SUM( r.real_refund_amount ), 0 ) AS amount
					FROM
						trade_refund r
						LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON o.id = r.order_id
					WHERE
						r.deleted = 0
						AND r.refund_status = 'success'
						AND DATE_FORMAT( r.real_refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = s.settlement_date
				) 
			) AS refund_total
		FROM
			trade_daily_settlement s
		WHERE
			s.deleted = 0
		 
		 
		 
			AND s.status = 1
		 
		ORDER BY s.settlement_date DESC LIMIT 30,10

	, SUM(CASE
		WHEN a.caseContactRst = 10 THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END) AS "可联数"
	, SUM(CASE
		WHEN a.is_success_in_range = 1 THEN a.case_amt
		ELSE 0
	END) AS "调解成功标的"
FROM (
	SELECT ce.id, ce.long_contact_rst AS caseContactRst, ce.dept_id, ce.plaintiff_id, ce.case_amt
		, ce.media_status
		, MAX(CASE
			WHEN cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101)

			WHEN ce.media_status = 300
				AND 1 = 1
				AND 1 = 1
			THEN 1
			ELSE 0
		END) AS is_success_in_range
	FROM case_enforce ce

		ON cbt.case_id = ce.id
			AND cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101)

		AND ce.register_date > '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
		AND ce.register_date < '2026-03-02 23:59:59'
		AND 1 = 1
	GROUP BY ce.id
) a
	LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.id = a.dept_id
GROUP BY a.dept_id
ORDER BY 调解成功数 DESC) t_11054567_HoCTNP WHERE (( 1=1 ) AND (1 IN ( 1 )))) no_dict_vdt) t    ) as a  limit 20000

SELECT
            DATE_FORMAT( dates.date, '%y-%m' ) AS month,
	        IFNULL( new_records.new_records_count, 0 ) AS newRecordsCount
        FROM ( SELECT CURDATE( ) - INTERVAL 11 MONTH + INTERVAL ( n - 1 ) MONTH AS date
            FROM (
            SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL
            SELECT 2 UNION ALL
            SELECT 3 UNION ALL
            SELECT 4 UNION ALL
            SELECT 5 UNION ALL
            SELECT 6 UNION ALL
            SELECT 7 UNION ALL
            SELECT 8 UNION ALL
            SELECT 9 UNION ALL
            SELECT 10 UNION ALL
            SELECT 11 UNION ALL
            SELECT 12) AS months) dates
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%b' ) AS MONTH,
            COUNT( 1 ) AS new_records_count FROM tms_driver_waybill
            WHERE del_flag = 0
            AND create_time >= DATE_SUB( NOW( ), INTERVAL 1 YEAR )
            GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%b')) new_records ON DATE_FORMAT( dates.date, '%b' ) = new_records.MONTH
            ORDER BY dates.date

SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN unload_time < ask_unload_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(load_time) AS ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        SUM(CASE WHEN unload_time < ask_unload_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS records_with_load_time_gt_ask_load_time
        FROM
        (
        SELECT
        ts.waybill_no,
        ts.load_time,
        ts.unload_time,
        ts.ask_unload_time,
        ts.supplier_id
        FROM
        tms_supplier_waybill ts

        WHERE
        ts.waybill_status NOT IN ( 0, 8, 9, 10 )
        AND ts.del_flag = 0
        AND ts.supplier_id = 1699978400509620226
        AND DATE_FORMAT( ts.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = '2026-02'

        UNION

        SELECT
        td.waybill_no,
        td.load_time,
        td.unload_time,
        td.ask_unload_time,
        td.supplier_id
        FROM
        tms_driver_waybill td
        WHERE
        td.waybill_status NOT IN ( 0, 8, 9, 10 )
        AND td.del_flag = 0
        AND td.supplier_id = 1699978400509620226
        AND DATE_FORMAT( td.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = '2026-02'
        AND
        NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tms_supplier_waybill ts
        WHERE ts.waybill_no = td.waybill_no
        )
        ) t

        GROUP BY
        t.supplier_id

IFNULL(X.else_JS, 0) + IFNULL(C.service_counter1, 0) AS else_JS,
IFNULL(X.total_JS, 0) + IFNULL(C.service_counter1, 0) AS total_JS,
X.created_at,
IFNULL(X.total_ZJ, 0)  - IFNULL(X.total_JS, 0)  - IFNULL(C.service_counter1, 0) AS residual_integral,
SUBSTR(X.created_at,1,7) AS created_at_ymonth
FROM
(
SELECT 
A.mall_id,
B.mall_bi_id,
B.mall_name,
B.area,
A.consumption_points,
A.photo_integral,
A.pos_points,
A.XS_consumption,
A.payment,
A.sign_in,
A.`upgrade`,
A.initiation,
A.supermarket_ZJ,
A.else_ZJ,
(A.consumption_points+
A.photo_integral+
A.XS_consumption+
A.payment+
A.sign_in+
A.`upgrade`+
A.initiation+
A.supermarket_ZJ+
A.else_ZJ) AS total_ZJ,
A.parking_fee,
A.lottery,
A.discounting,
A.apply,
A.store,
A.supermarket_JS,
A.else_JS,
(A.parking_fee+
A.lottery+
A.discounting+
A.apply+
A.store+
A.supermarket_JS+
A.else_JS)AS total_JS,
A.created_at
FROM
(
 -- 将积分按照逻辑进行分类
SELECT
str_to_date(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at, 
mall_id,
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('无感积分-支付宝', '无感积分-微信', '购物积分-小程序收银', '购物积分-小票上传', '线上消费奖励', '消费送积分-CRM同步') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'consumption_points',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ( '购物积分-小票上传') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'photo_integral',
NULL  AS 'pos_points',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('购物积分-小程序收银', '线上消费奖励') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'XS_consumption',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('无感积分-支付宝', '无感积分-微信') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'payment',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('签到') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'sign_in',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('升级赠送') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'upgrade',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('首次注册') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'initiation',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('第三方同步-BHG生活超市兑换积分') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'supermarket_ZJ',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('互动游戏奖励积分', '商品支付退回', '完善信息', '导入会员积分同步', '第三方同步-玩第三方脸脸游戏奖励积分', '第三方同步-玩脸脸游戏奖励积分', '第三方同步-移动PLUS会员领取积分奖励', '第三方同步-第三方同步-移动PLUS会员积分奖励', '第三方同步-脸脸游戏积分返还', '退款返还抵扣积分', '兑换订单退积分', '消费送积分-CRM同步', '第三方同步-乐摩吧积分补录', '第三方同步-湿厕纸积分退回', '第三方同步-湿厕纸测试积分收入', 'pos积分抵扣退回') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'else_ZJ',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('停车缴费积分抵现') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'parking_fee',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('营销活动-九宫格转盘','营销活动-幸运扭蛋机','互动游戏扣积分') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'lottery',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('线上消费积分抵现') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'discounting',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('营销活动-报名活动') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'apply',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('商城兑换') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'store',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ('BHG生活超市兑换积分') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'supermarket_JS',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN origin IN ( '商品支付', '积分清零', '第三方同步-玩第三方脸脸游戏消减积分', '第三方同步-玩脸脸游戏消减积分', '第三方同步-购物积分-自助商城兑换', '退款收回奖励积分', '第三方同步-乐摩吧积分抵扣', '第三方同步-其他', '第三方同步-湿厕纸积分兑换', '第三方同步-湿厕纸测试积分扣除', '第三方同步-鲲鲸云充电宝积分抵扣', '第三方同步-购物积分-自助', 'pos积分抵扣') THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'else_JS'
FROM 
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS
-- 更新近5天数据
WHERE created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY str_to_date(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d'), mall_id
) A
LEFT JOIN -- 关联维度表获取bi_id
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_MALL_MAP B
ON A.mall_id = B.mall_id
ORDER BY A.created_at, A.mall_id
) X
LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT -- 判断服务台记录中的增减积分
mall_id,
str_to_date(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at, 
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'service_counter',
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS.change END), 0) AS 'service_counter1'
FROM
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS
WHERE origin IN ('服务台记录')
-- 更新近5天数据
AND created_at >= CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL -5 DAY),' 00:00:00') 
AND created_at <= CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(),' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY mall_id,str_to_date(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
) C
ON X.created_at = C.created_at AND X.mall_id = C.mall_id

SELECT

	org.ou_name '供应商',
	main.sku_id 'SkuId',
  CASE WHEN (sku.source_name IS NOT NULL AND sku.source_name <> '') THEN (CONCAT('【',sku.source_name, '】', sku.sku_name)) ELSE sku.sku_name END '产品名称',
	order_cnt '订单笔数',
	number '销售数量',
	use_number '验证数量(核销/入住离店)',
	ROUND( pay_amount, 2 ) '销售金额',
	ROUND( cost_amount, 2 ) '销售成本',
	ROUND(( pay_amount - cost_amount ), 2 ) '销售利润',
	ROUND(( pay_amount - cost_amount )/ number, 2 ) '平均利润',
	ROUND(service_charge, 2 ) '退款手续费'
FROM
	(
	
	SELECT
			etp_sup_ou_code,
			order_mode,
			count( DISTINCT trade_no) order_cnt,
			sku_id,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(number, 0) else 0 end) number,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(use_number, 0) else 0 end) use_number,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) else 0 end) pay_amount,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(cost_amount, 0) else 0 end) cost_amount,
			sum(IFNULL(refund_number,0)) refund_number,
			sum(IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) refund_amount,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) > 0) then (IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) - IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) else 0 end) service_charge
		FROM
			ord_shopping_order_item_detail 
		WHERE 1=1 
			and order_type in ('200017001', '200024001') 
			and  paid_time     between '2026-02-01 00:00:00' and '2026-02-11 23:59:59'  
			and  1=1 
		GROUP BY
			etp_sup_ou_code,
			order_mode,
			sku_id 
		UNION ALL
		
		select 
			mch_ou_code etp_sup_ou_code,
			30 order_mode,
			count( DISTINCT trade_no ) order_cnt,
			sku_id,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) = 0) then 1 else 0 end) number,
			sum(case when (state = 3) then 1 else 0 end) use_number,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) else 0 end) pay_amount,
			sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(cost_price, 0) else 0 end) cost_amount,

select count(1)  from ( select
	main.ou_code '分销商编码',
  IFNULL(max(org.etp_name), '一键游小程序') '分销商',
	CONCAT(max(org.province_name),'/',max(org.city_name),'/',max(org.area_name)) '所在区域',
	sum(case when number > 0 then 1 else 0 end) '订单笔数',
	sum(number) '销售数量',
	ROUND(sum(settle_amount), 2) '结算金额',
	ROUND(sum(pay_amount), 2) '销售金额',
	ROUND(sum(pay_amount), 2) '分销金额',
	ROUND(sum(cost_amount), 2) '销售成本',
	ROUND(sum(service_charge), 2) '退款手续费',
	ROUND(sum(pay_amount) - sum(cost_amount), 2) '销售利润',
	CONCAT(ROUND((sum(pay_amount) - sum(cost_amount))/sum(cost_amount)*100, 2),'%') '总利润率'
from 
 (
select 
	a.*, IFNULL(b.ou_code, '0') ou_code
from 
(

select 
SUBSTRING(etp_sup_ou_code, 1, 7) etp_sup_ou_code,
order_mode,
trade_no,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(number, 0) else 0 end) number,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) else 0 end) pay_amount,
sum(IFNULL(settle_amount, 0)) settle_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(cost_amount, 0) else 0 end) cost_amount,
sum(IFNULL(refund_number,0)) refund_number,
sum(IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) refund_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_number, 0) > 0) then (IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) - IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) else 0 end) service_charge
from ord_shopping_order_item_detail 
where 1=1 
and etp_sup_ou_code like '2%'
and order_type in ('200017001', '200024001')
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
and  Date(checkin_time)     between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'  
group by SUBSTRING(etp_sup_ou_code, 1, 7), order_mode, trade_no union all

select 
SUBSTRING(mch_ou_code, 1, 7) etp_sup_ou_code,
30 order_mode,
trade_no,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) = 0) then 1 else 0 end) number,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) else 0 end) pay_amount,
sum(IFNULL(settle_amount, 0)) settle_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) = 0) then IFNULL(cost_price, 0) else 0 end) cost_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) > 0) then 1 else 0 end) refund_number,
sum(IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) refund_amount,
sum(case when (IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) > 0) then (IFNULL(pay_amount, 0) - IFNULL(refund_amount,0)) else 0 end) service_charge
from coupon_virtual_product 
where 1=1 
and mch_ou_code like '2%'
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
and  use_time     between '2026-02-23 00:00:00' and '2026-02-23 23:59:59'  
group by SUBSTRING(mch_ou_code, 1, 7), trade_no union ALL

select 
SUBSTRING(etp_sup_ou_code, 1, 7) etp_sup_ou_code,
0 order_mode,
trade_no,
sum(number - IFNULL(refund_number,0)) number,
sum(pay_amount) pay_amount,
sum(settle_amount) settle_amount,
sum(cost_price * (number - IFNULL(refund_number,0))) cost_amount,
0 refund_number,
0 refund_amount,
0 service_charge

and etp_sup_ou_code like '2%'

and number - IFNULL(refund_number,0) > 0

  ou_code,

	real_amount pay_amount 
from ord_enterprise_distribute_order

 )main

		 1=1

  and (case when ('1002001001' like '2%') then main.ou_code like '1002001001%' else 1=1 end)
group by main.ou_code order by main.ou_code ) tmp_group

select record_order_id as order_id, FROM_UNIXTIME(spin_time , '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as order_time,
               total_bet as order_bet,total_win as order_win, theme_id,user_id,bei_rate,total_bet - total_win as surplus,
               condition_num, event_str, channel_id, previous_gold , later_gold, cost_free_bet
         
        from (
         
            select convert(total_bet,SIGNED) as total_bet, convert(total_win,SIGNED) as total_win,
                theme_id,spin_time,user_id,round(total_win / total_bet,2) as bei_rate,
                condition_num, event_str, channel_id, previous_gold, later_gold
                 
                        , record_order_id, cost_free_bet
                     
            from plug_slots_game.spin_log
            where user_id not in (select user_id from plug_slots_game.user_white_list)
             
             
             
             
             
             
             
             
                 
                        and channel_id in (73, 75, 76, 77, 91)
                     
             
             
         
            and spin_time> UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-03-05 16:00:00')
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
            and theme_id = 1
         
         
     
            union all
         
        select convert(total_bet,SIGNED) as total_bet, convert(total_win,SIGNED) as total_win,
                theme_id,spin_time,user_id,round(total_win / total_bet,2) as bei_rate,
                condition_num, event_str, channel_id, previous_gold, later_gold
                 
                        , record_order_id, cost_free_bet
                     
        from plug_slots_log.`spin_log_2026-03-05`
        where user_id not in (select user_id from plug_slots_game.user_white_list)
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
             
                    and channel_id in (73, 75, 76, 77, 91)
                 
         
         
         
            and spin_time> UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-03-05 16:00:00')
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
            and theme_id = 1
         
         
     
        ) tmp

	, b.成功标的

			, MAX(CASE
				WHEN cbt.tag_id IN (35, 77, 101) THEN 1

			AND 1 = 1
			AND 1 = 1
		GROUP BY ce.id
	) a
	GROUP BY a.plaintiff_id
) b
	LEFT JOIN `user` u ON b.plaintiff_id = u.id
ORDER BY b.案件总数 DESC) t_11054567_aivgJp WHERE (( 1=1 ) AND (1 IN ( 1 )))) no_dict_vdt) t    ) as a  ) count_sub

			AND ce.register_date < '2026-02-28 23:59:07'
			AND 1 = 1
			AND 1 = 1
		GROUP BY ce.id
	) a
	GROUP BY a.plaintiff_id
) b
	LEFT JOIN `user` u ON b.plaintiff_id = u.id

select A.ContractsID
	 ,CASE WHEN C.UnitPrice_BQM - A.UnitPrice_BQ > 0 THEN 1 END 本期租金加营运
	 ,CASE WHEN D.UnitPrice_TQM - B.UnitPrice_TQ > 0 THEN 1 END 同期租金加营运
from (
	-- 本期值
	select ContractsID,sum(UnitPrice) as UnitPrice_BQ from TB_DW_NEW_CONFORMULA
	where ChargeTypeID in  ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a') 
	and FStartDate <= '2023-05-03' and FEndDate >= '2023-05-09'
	group by ContractsID
	)A 
	LEFT JOIN 
	(
	-- 同期值
	select ContractsID,sum(UnitPrice) as UnitPrice_TQ from TB_DW_NEW_CONFORMULA
	where ChargeTypeID in  ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a') 
	and FStartDate <= '2022-05-03' and FEndDate >= '2022-05-09'
	group by ContractsID
	)B ON A.ContractsID=B.ContractsID

	left join

	-- 租金+营运管理费
	(
	-- 本期值
	select ContractsID,sum(UnitPrice) as UnitPrice_BQM from TB_DW_NEW_CONFORMULA
	where ChargeTypeID in  ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a','101','226','afc0b818-4ab5-4aee-b642-1e8a8c3828f9') 
	and FStartDate <= '2023-05-03' and FEndDate >= '2023-05-09'
	group by ContractsID
	)C on  A.ContractsID=C.ContractsID
	LEFT JOIN 
	(
	-- 同期值
	select ContractsID,sum(UnitPrice) as UnitPrice_TQM from TB_DW_NEW_CONFORMULA
	where ChargeTypeID in  ('214','17f43055-3816-4983-9dd0-cbe3eb4a6d6a','101','226','afc0b818-4ab5-4aee-b642-1e8a8c3828f9') 
	and FStartDate <= '2022-05-03' and FEndDate >= '2022-05-09'
	group by ContractsID
	)D ON A.ContractsID=D.ContractsID

SELECT store_total.*
        ,CONCAT(
        '[',
        GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT
        JSON_OBJECT(
        CONCAT('1',month_total.salesDate,'销售累计'),
        month_total.salesAmount,
        CONCAT('2',month_total.salesDate,'销售指标'),
        month_total.salesPlan,
        CONCAT('3',month_total.salesDate,'指标完成率'),
        IF(month_total.salesPlan = 0 , 100, TRUNCATE((month_total.salesAmount/month_total.salesPlan)*100,2))
        )),
        ']'
        )  AS monthTotal
        ,CONCAT(
        '[',
        GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT
        JSON_OBJECT(
        CONCAT('1',year_total.salesDate,'销售累计'),
        year_total.salesAmount,
        CONCAT('2',year_total.salesDate,'销售指标'),
        year_total.salesPlan,
        CONCAT('3',year_total.salesDate,'指标完成率'),
        IF(year_total.salesPlan = 0 , 100, TRUNCATE((year_total.salesAmount/year_total.salesPlan)*100,2))
        )),
        ']'
        )  AS yearTotal
        FROM (
        SELECT
        a.store_id AS storeId,
        a.store_name AS storeName,
        SUM( a.sales_amount ) AS salesAmount,
        b.lastAmount,
        TRUNCATE((SUM( a.sales_amount ) - b.lastAmount)/b.lastAmount*100,2) AS yoyRate
        FROM
        sales_goods_report a
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT sgr.store_id,SUM( sales_amount ) AS lastAmount FROM sales_goods_report sgr WHERE
        sgr.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= DATE_SUB('2026-02-01',INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_SUB('2026-02-28',INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY sgr.store_id) b ON b.store_id = a.store_id
        WHERE
        a.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( a.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= '2026-02-01'
        AND DATE_FORMAT( a.sales_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= '2026-02-28'
         
        GROUP BY a.store_id) store_total
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sgr.store_id,
        DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y年%m月' ) AS salesDate,
        SUM( sgr.sales_amount ) AS salesAmount,
        IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SALES) FROM jpaas_erp.erp_plan_floor pf WHERE pf.MALL = sgr.store_id AND pf.YEARMONTH = DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y%m' )),0) AS salesPlan
        FROM
        sales_goods_report sgr
        WHERE
        sgr.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m' ) >= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-01' ,'%Y-%m')
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y-%m' ) <= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-28' ,'%Y-%m')
        GROUP BY sgr.store_id,DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time,'%Y-%m' )) month_total ON month_total.store_id = store_total.storeId
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
        sgr.store_id,
        DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y年' ) AS salesDate,
        SUM( sgr.sales_amount ) AS salesAmount,
        IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SALES) FROM jpaas_erp.erp_plan_floor pf WHERE pf.MALL = sgr.store_id AND pf.YEARMONTH = DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y%m' )),0) AS salesPlan
        FROM
        sales_goods_report sgr
        WHERE
        sgr.store_id IS NOT NULL
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y' ) >= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-01' ,'%Y')
        AND DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time, '%Y' ) <= DATE_FORMAT('2026-02-28' ,'%Y')
        GROUP BY sgr.store_id,DATE_FORMAT( sgr.sales_time,'%Y' )) year_total ON year_total.store_id = store_total.storeId
        GROUP BY store_total.storeId

SELECT 
PRO_CODE
,ContractsCode 
,UnitTypeCode
,ContractsID
,'2025-09' AS FileDate
,SUM(CASE WHEN ChargeTypeID = 214 THEN PRICE END ) GDZJ
,SUM(CASE WHEN ChargeTypeID = 101 OR ChargeTypeID = 226 THEN PRICE END ) YYGL
FROM (
SELECT ContractsCode
			,ChargeTypeID
			,PRO_CODE
			,UnitTypeCode
			,ContractsID
			,SUM(price)/SUM(RentArea) PRICE
FROM (
				SELECT ContractsCode
										,UNITID
										,PRO_CODE
										,ChargeTypeID
										,UnitTypeCode
										,ContractsID
										,MAX(UsableArea) RentArea
										,SUM(FirstValue*UsableArea) price
							FROM (
				#以下是基准价面积等等字段sql过程
										SELECT  A.ContractsCode -- 租约号
													 ,A.UNITID -- 铺位id
													 ,A.RENTSTANDARDYEAR -- 年度
													 ,A.UsableArea -- 面积
													 ,A.FIRSTVALUE -- 基准价
													 ,A.BizMode -- 类型
													 ,CASE WHEN A.RentStandardItemID = 'fea18352-3379-4990-ab25-4469cb1a5e1c' THEN 4
																 WHEN A.RentStandardItemID = '858bd22e-8728-4781-831e-6c8a3f4a10b6' THEN 3 END RentStandardItemID -- 每周前四后三天
												   ,ChargeTypeID
													 ,A.PRO_CODE
													 ,A.UnitTypeCode
													 ,A.ContractsID
										FROM (-- 基准价表筛选有效的后关联基准价总表并且显示面积
													SELECT ContractsCode -- 租约号
																,B.UNITID -- 铺位id
																,RENTSTANDARDYEAR
																,UsableArea
																,FIRSTVALUE
																,BizMode
																,D.RentStandardItemID
																,ChargeTypeID	
																,PRO_CODE
																,UnitTypeCode
																,ContractsID
													FROM (SELECT ContractsCode 
																			,UNITID
																			,UsableArea
																			,BizMode
																			,PRO_CODE
																			,UnitTypeCode
																			,ContractsID
																FROM TB_DW_NEW_UNIT_CONTRACT
																WHERE BizMode = 1 
																and ContractsID IN (-- 新签合同
select 
A.ContractsID
FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS_SIGN A
WHERE FileDate='2025-09'  -- 动态年月
																															)
																			) B
															 INNER JOIN 
															 
														   (SELECT D.RentStandardID
																			,D.RentStandardYear
																			,D.RentStandardItemID
																			,D.FirstValue
																			,D.UnitID
																			,D.ChargeTypeID
															 FROM (SELECT A.RentStandardID
																						,RentStandardYear
																						,RentStandardItemID
																						,FirstValue
																						,UnitID
																						,ChargeTypeID
																			FROM TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARD A
																					 LEFT JOIN 
																					 TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARDDETAIL B
																					 ON 
																					 A.RentStandardID = B.RentStandardID
																			WHERE RentStandardStatus = 1 -- 筛选有效
																						-- 筛选费用类型
																						AND ChargeTypeID in ('101','214','226') -- 固定租金
																						) D  INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(RentStandardYear) RentStandardYear
																																																					,UnitID
																																																		FROM TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARD A
																																																				 LEFT JOIN 
																																																				 TB_ODS_NEW_MI_RENTSTANDARDDETAIL B
																																																				 ON 
																																																				 A.RentStandardID = B.RentStandardID
																																																		WHERE RentStandardStatus = 1 -- 筛选有效
																																																					-- 筛选费用类型
																																																					AND ChargeTypeID in ('101','214','226')  -- 固定租金
																																																		GROUP BY UnitID) E ON D.UnitID = E.UnitID AND D.RENTSTANDARDYEAR = E.RentStandardYear ) D
																			
																			
																ON B.UNITID = D.UNITID
													 ) A
				#以上是基准价面积等等字段sql	
										) AA
							
							GROUP BY ContractsCode ,UNITID,ChargeTypeID
							) AA

GROUP BY ContractsCode,ChargeTypeID


) AA
GROUP BY ContractsCode
ORDER BY PRO_CODE

SELECT
			s.id,
			s.settlement_date,
			a.campus_id,
			( SELECT c.`name` FROM bd_campus c WHERE c.id = a.campus_id ) AS campus_name,
			a.business_id,
			( SELECT c.`name` FROM bc_business c WHERE c.id = a.business_id ) AS businessName,
			a.`status`,
			IFNULL( t.receipt_total, 0 ) AS receipt_total,
			a.modified_time modified_time,
			(select nickname from uc_user u where u.id=a.modified_uid) modifiedBy
		FROM
			trade_daily_settlement s
			LEFT JOIN trade_daily_settlement_audit a ON a.daily_settlement_id = s.id AND a.type = 1
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT
					DATE_FORMAT( o.pay_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS date,
					o.business_id,
					p.receipt_campus_id,
					IFNULL( SUM( p.payment_amount ), 0 ) AS receipt_total
				FROM
					trade_order o
					LEFT JOIN trade_order_payment p ON p.order_id = o.id AND p.pay_type = 'offline' 
				WHERE
					o.deleted = 0
					AND o.order_status = 1
				 
				 
				 
				 
				GROUP BY
					DATE_FORMAT( o.pay_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ),
					o.business_id,
					p.receipt_campus_id
			) t 
				ON t.date = s.settlement_date 
				AND IF( a.business_id IS NULL, TRUE, t.business_id = a.business_id ) 
				AND t.receipt_campus_id = a.campus_id
		WHERE
			s.deleted = 0 and a.deleted = 0
		 
		 
		 
		 
		 
		 
	        and (a.business_id IN
	         (  
	            4
	         ) 
	        or a.business_id is null
	        )
	     
		 
			AND a.`status` = 1
		 
		GROUP BY
			s.id,
			a.business_id,
			a.campus_id 
		ORDER BY
			s.settlement_date DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 
品牌ID,合同ID,品牌名称,一级业态,三级业态,面积,租售比,
CASE 
WHEN 租售比 < YJ_VALUE THEN '1'
WHEN 租售比 >= YJ_VALUE and 租售比 < GJ_VALUE THEN '0'
ELSE '-1' END AS 状态
FROM (
SELECT 
A.合同ID,A.品牌ID, A.品牌名称, A.一级业态,A.三级业态, SUM(A.面积) AS 面积, SUM(B.租金收入) AS 租金收入,SUM(C.销售额) AS 销售额,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(C.销售额),0) = 0 OR IFNULL(SUM(B.租金收入) ,0) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE SUM(B.租金收入) /SUM(C.销售额) END AS 租售比 
FROM (
-- 合同信息
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID,
BrandID AS 品牌ID,
BrandName AS 品牌名称,
TradeRelationName1 AS 一级业态,
TradeRelationName3 AS 三级业态,
RentArea AS 面积
FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS
WHERE Pro_Code in ('60002')
and BizMode=1 -- 取租赁
-- and ContractsStatus in (3) -- 合同状态为进行中
-- 合同有效期包含在所选月且合同开始日非所选月首日/合同结束日非所选月最后一日的
AND '2026-02' >= LEFT(ChargeStartDate,7)  -- 
AND '2026-02' <= LEFT(ConStopDate,7) 
AND (ChargeStartDate  !=  CONCAT('2026-02','-01') AND ConStopDate != '2026-02-28')
AND TradeRelationName1 IN ('零售','餐饮','儿童','娱乐体验','健康&生活')
AND  ContractsStatus != 10
) A LEFT JOIN (
-- 租金收入
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID
,SUM(YS+TZ) AS 租金收入
FROM TB_DW_NEW_ARREARS_CENTER_CC
WHERE BizPeriod = '2026-02' 
AND ChargeTypeID IN ('214','215','230','101','226') -- 费项（固定租金、抽成租金、年度抽成，营运管理费、营运管理费（C））
AND PRO_CODE= '60002'
GROUP BY ContractsID
)B ON A.合同ID=B.合同ID
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID
,SUM(PAIDAMT) AS 销售额 -- 销售额
FROM TB_DW_NEW_PRO_MARKET
WHERE 1=1
AND PRO_DATE >= CONCAT('2026-02','-01')
AND PRO_DATE <= '2026-02-28'
AND PRO_CODE IN ('60002')
GROUP BY ContractsID
)C ON A.合同ID=C.合同ID
GROUP BY A.合同ID,A.品牌ID, A.品牌名称, A.一级业态,A.三级业态
)P -- 关联租售比预警值
LEFT JOIN TB_FILL_MOBILE_ZSB ZSB 
ON P.三级业态=ZSB.COMMERCIAL_FORM
)A 
ORDER BY 租售比 DESC

select 
M.TradeRelationName2,
M.TradeRelationName1,
SUM(M.PAIDAMT_BQ)/10000 as PAIDAMT_BQ,
SUM(M.Qty_BQ) AS Qty_BQ,
SUM(M.RENTAL_AREA_BQ)/10000 as RentArea_BQ,
SUM(M.DianPu_BQ) AS DianPu_BQ
from (


select a.pro_code,a.PRO_AREA,a.TradeRelationName2,a.ContractsID,SUM(a.PAIDAMT) AS PAIDAMT_BQ,SUM(a.Qty) as Qty_BQ ,SUM(b.RENTAL_AREA) as RENTAL_AREA_BQ, count(a.ContractsID) as DianPu_BQ ,a.TradeRelationName1 from (
select pro.PRO_CODE,pro.PRO_AREA,con.ContractsID,
case when con.TradeRelationName2 is null or con.TradeRelationName2 ='' then '业态为空'
else con.TradeRelationName2 end as TradeRelationName2,con.TradeRelationName1,
sum(PAIDAMT) AS PAIDAMT,
sum(Qty) as Qty
from TB_DW_NEW_TRANSSKUMEDIA tra
left join TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS con on tra.ContractsID=con.ContractsID
left join TB_DIM_PROJECT pro on tra.STOREID=pro.DP_CODE
where pro.PRO_CODE in ('60020')
and PRO_DATE >= '2024-01-01' and PRO_DATE <=  '2024-12-30'
and con.BizMode =1 -- 只取商铺类型为租赁
-- and con.TradeRelationName1 in ('')
group by pro.PRO_CODE,pro.PRO_AREA,con.ContractsID,con.TradeRelationName2,TradeRelationName1
) a
left join (
-- 面积快照表：终止时间生效合同面积之和
select a.PRO_CODE,a.ContractsID,sum(a.RENTAL_AREA) as RENTAL_AREA from TB_DW_NEW_EMPTY a
where  a.PRO_CODE in ('60020')
and a.BizMode =1 -- 只取商铺类型为租赁
and a.FILE_DATE =  '2024-12-30'
group by a.PRO_CODE,a.ContractsID
) b on a.pro_code=b.pro_code and a.ContractsID=b.ContractsID
GROUP BY a.pro_code,a.PRO_AREA,a.TradeRelationName2,a.ContractsID,a.TradeRelationName1) M
group by M.TradeRelationName2,M.TradeRelationName1

SELECT ih.invoice_header_id
FROM lsbm_invoice_header ih

WHERE ih.special_ticket_flag = 'Y' and ih.invoice_source = 'HSAP'
AND (ih.tax_bill_different_flag IS NULL OR ih.tax_bill_different_flag != 'Y')

AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lsbm_invoice_relate_document ird
    WHERE ird.invoice_header_id = ih.invoice_header_id and (ird.relate_document_type = 'Payment_Application' or ird.relate_document_type = 'Receipt')
)

AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lsbm_invoice_relate_document ird
    LEFT JOIN hsbm_payment_req_headers prh 
      ON ird.relate_document_id = prh.payment_req_header_id AND ird.relate_document_type = 'Payment_Application'
    LEFT JOIN hsbm_receipt_headers rh 
      ON ird.relate_document_id = rh.receipt_header_id AND ird.relate_document_type = 'Receipt'
    WHERE ird.invoice_header_id = ih.invoice_header_id AND COALESCE(prh.end_date, rh.end_date) IS NULL
)

AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lsbm_invoice_relate_document ird
    WHERE ird.invoice_header_id = ih.invoice_header_id and (ird.relate_document_type = 'Payment_Application' or ird.relate_document_type = 'Receipt')
    AND ird.last_approved_doc_flag = 'Y'
)

SELECT
            table_a.business_unit_code,
            table_a.poi_id,
            table_b.created_time AS push_create_time,
            (
                SELECT
                    shop_code
                FROM
                    busi_checkup_result
                WHERE
                    business_unit_code = table_a.business_unit_code
                  AND poi_id = table_a.poi_id
                ORDER BY
                    created_time DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS shop_code,
            (
                SELECT
                    created_time
                FROM
                    busi_checkup_result
                WHERE
                    business_unit_code = table_a.business_unit_code
                  AND poi_id = table_a.poi_id
                ORDER BY
                    created_time DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS cloudCreateTime
        FROM
            (

                SELECT
                    btpf.poi_id,
                    btpt.business_unit_code
                from busi_top_poi_feedback btpf
                         inner join busi_top_poi btp on btpf.poi_id = btp.poi_id and btpf.delete_flag = 0 and btpf.shop_trans_status != 1
                         left join busi_top_poi_task  btpt on btp.task_id = btpt.gd_task_id
            ) AS table_a
                INNER JOIN
            (
                SELECT
                    btppt.created_time,
                    btpf.poi_id
                from busi_top_poi_feedback btpf
                         inner join busi_top_poi_push_log btppl on btpf.poi_id = btppl.poi_id
                         inner join busi_top_poi_push_task btppt on btppl.push_task_id = btppt.id  and btppt.task_status = 'SUCCESS'
            ) AS table_b
            ON table_a.poi_id = table_b.poi_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT SUM(a.`produce_num`) AS `total_num`, SUM(a.`local_area_num`) AS `local_area_num`, SUM(a.`diff_area_num`) AS `diff_area_num`, SUM(a.`live_clue_num`) AS `live_clue_num`, SUM(a.`first_contact_num`) AS `first_contact_num`, SUM(a.`contact_num`) AS `contact_num`, SUM(a.`effective_num`) AS `effective_num`, SUM(a.`arrive_num`) AS `arrive_num`, SUM(a.`deal_num`) AS `deal_num`, SUM(b.`receive_num`) AS `receive_num`, IFNULL(CEILING(SUM(a.produce_num) / SUM(b.dealer_count)), 0) AS dj_num, IFNULL(CEILING(SUM(a.live_clue_num) / SUM(b.live_session_count)), 0) AS per_live_avg_num, IFNULL(c.city_name, '未知') AS `city_name` FROM nmo_base_city c LEFT JOIN (SELECT `dealer_city_id`, SUM(`produce_num`) AS `produce_num`, SUM(`local_area_num`) AS `local_area_num`, SUM(`diff_area_num`) AS `diff_area_num`, SUM(`live_clue_num`) AS `live_clue_num`, SUM(`first_contact_num`) AS `first_contact_num`, SUM(`contact_num`) AS `contact_num`, SUM(`effective_num`) AS `effective_num`, SUM(`arrive_num`) AS `arrive_num`, SUM(`deal_num`) AS `deal_num` FROM `nmo_stat_clue_account` WHERE dealer_city_id IS NOT NULL AND stat_date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND stat_date < '2026-03-10 00:00:00' AND dealer_id IN (SELECT id FROM `sys_depart` WHERE org_code LIKE CONCAT('A01A04A03A11', '%')) GROUP BY `dealer_city_id`) a ON a.dealer_city_id = c.id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT city_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dealer_id) AS dealer_count, SUM(live_session_count) AS live_session_count, SUM(receive_num) AS receive_num FROM `nmo_stat_clue_receive` WHERE stat_date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND stat_date < '2026-03-10 00:00:00' AND dealer_id IN (SELECT id FROM `sys_depart` WHERE org_code LIKE CONCAT('A01A04A03A11', '%')) GROUP BY city_id) b ON b.city_id = c.id LEFT OUTER JOIN `nmo_base_area` d ON c.province_id = d.id WHERE main_area_name != '其他' GROUP BY c.`city_name`) t

select 
M.PRO_AREA,M.Pro_Code,M.ContractsCode,M.BrandName,
LEFT(M.ConStartDate,10) AS ConStartDate,
LEFT(M.ConStopDate,10) AS ConStopDate,
M.TradeRelationName1,
M.PAIDAMT_BQ as PAIDAMT_BQ,
M.Qty_BQ AS Qty_BQ,
M.RENTAL_AREA_BQ as RentArea_BQ,
N.PAIDAMT_TQ as PAIDAMT_TQ,
N.Qty_TQ AS Qty_TQ,
N.RENTAL_AREA_TQ as RentArea_TQ
 from (
-- 本期数据
select a.*,b.RENTAL_AREA as RENTAL_AREA_BQ 
from (
select pro.PRO_CODE,pro.PRO_AREA,con.ContractsID,con.ContractsCode,con.ConStartDate,con.ConStopDate,
case when con.TradeRelationName1 is null or con.TradeRelationName1 ='' then '业态为空'
else con.TradeRelationName1 end as TradeRelationName1,con.BrandName,
sum(PAIDAMT) AS PAIDAMT_BQ,
sum(Qty) as Qty_BQ
from TB_DW_NEW_TRANSSKUMEDIA tra
left join TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS con on tra.ContractsID=con.ContractsID
left join TB_DIM_PROJECT pro on tra.STOREID=pro.DP_CODE
where pro.PRO_CODE in ('60058')
and PRO_DATE >= '2025-01-01' and PRO_DATE <= '2025-12-31'
and con.TradeRelationName1 in ('专业店类','休闲娱乐类','健康&生活','儿童','其他','家居','服务类','服饰','未知','零售','非零售','餐饮','餐饮类')
group by pro.PRO_CODE,pro.PRO_AREA,con.ContractsID,con.TradeRelationName1
) a
left join (
-- 面积快照表：终止时间生效合同面积之和
select a.PRO_CODE,a.ContractsID,sum(a.RENTAL_AREA) as RENTAL_AREA from TB_DW_NEW_EMPTY a
where  a.PRO_CODE in ('60058')
and a.BizMode =1 -- 只取商铺类型为租赁
and a.FILE_DATE='2025-12-31'
group by a.PRO_CODE,a.ContractsID
) b on a.pro_code=b.pro_code and a.ContractsID=b.ContractsID

)M LEFT JOIN (
-- 同期数据
select a.*,b.RENTAL_AREA as RENTAL_AREA_TQ
from (
select pro.PRO_CODE,pro.PRO_AREA,con.ContractsID,con.ContractsCode,con.ConStartDate,con.ConStopDate,
case when con.TradeRelationName1 is null or con.TradeRelationName1 ='' then '业态为空'
else con.TradeRelationName1 end as TradeRelationName1,con.BrandName,
sum(PAIDAMT) AS PAIDAMT_TQ,
sum(Qty) as Qty_TQ
from TB_DW_NEW_TRANSSKUMEDIA tra
left join TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS con on tra.ContractsID=con.ContractsID
left join TB_DIM_PROJECT pro on tra.STOREID=pro.DP_CODE
where pro.PRO_CODE in ('60058')
and con.TradeRelationName1 in ('专业店类','休闲娱乐类','健康&生活','儿童','其他','家居','服务类','服饰','未知','零售','非零售','餐饮','餐饮类')
and PRO_DATE >= '2024-01-01' and PRO_DATE <= '2024-12-30'
group by pro.PRO_CODE,pro.PRO_AREA,con.ContractsID,con.TradeRelationName1
) a
left join (
-- 面积快照表：终止时间生效合同面积之和
select a.PRO_CODE,a.ContractsID,sum(a.RENTAL_AREA) as RENTAL_AREA from TB_DW_NEW_EMPTY a
where  a.PRO_CODE in ('60058')
and a.BizMode =1 -- 只取商铺类型为租赁
and a.FILE_DATE='2024-12-30'
group by a.PRO_CODE,a.ContractsID
) b on a.pro_code=b.pro_code and a.ContractsID=b.ContractsID
) N ON M.Pro_Code=N.Pro_Code AND M.ContractsID=N.ContractsID 
ORDER BY M.TradeRelationName1

select * from(
SELECT 
A.PRO_CODE,SUM(A.面积) AS 面积, SUM(B.租金收入) AS 租金收入,SUM(C.销售额) AS 销售额,
CASE 
WHEN IFNULL(SUM(C.销售额),0) = 0 OR IFNULL(SUM(B.租金收入) ,0) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE SUM(B.租金收入) /SUM(C.销售额) END AS 租售比 
FROM (
-- 合同信息
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID,Pro_Code,
BrandID AS 品牌ID,
BrandName AS 品牌名称,
TradeRelationName1 AS 一级业态,
TradeRelationName3 AS 三级业态,
RentArea AS 面积
FROM TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS
WHERE BizMode=1 -- 取租赁
-- and ContractsStatus in (3) -- 合同状态为进行中
-- 合同有效期包含在所选月且合同开始日非所选月首日/合同结束日非所选月最后一日的
and PRO_CODE in (
-- 项目权限
SELECT PRO_CODE FROM TB_FILL_CDEMO WHERE DEMO_CODE= '3007诊断.frm' AND SHOW_IF = '是')
AND '2026-01' >= LEFT(ChargeStartDate,7)  -- 
AND '2026-01' <= LEFT(ConStopDate,7) 
AND (ChargeStartDate  !=  CONCAT('2026-01','-01') AND ConStopDate != '2026-01-31')
AND TradeRelationName1 IN ('零售','餐饮','儿童','娱乐体验','健康&生活')
AND  ContractsStatus != 10
) A LEFT JOIN (
-- 租金收入
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID,PRO_CODE
,SUM(YS+TZ) AS 租金收入
FROM TB_DW_NEW_ARREARS_CENTER_CC
WHERE BizPeriod = '2026-01' 
AND ChargeTypeID IN ('214','215','230','101','226') -- 费项（固定租金、抽成租金、年度抽成，营运管理费、营运管理费（C））
and PRO_CODE in (
-- 项目权限
SELECT PRO_CODE FROM TB_FILL_CDEMO WHERE DEMO_CODE= '3007诊断.frm' AND SHOW_IF = '是')
GROUP BY ContractsID,PRO_CODE
)B ON A.合同ID=B.合同ID
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT 
ContractsID AS 合同ID,PRO_CODE
,SUM(PAIDAMT) AS 销售额 -- 销售额
FROM TB_DW_NEW_PRO_MARKET
WHERE 1=1
AND PRO_DATE >= CONCAT('2026-01','-01')
AND PRO_DATE <= '2026-01-31'
and PRO_CODE in (
-- 项目权限
SELECT PRO_CODE FROM TB_FILL_CDEMO WHERE DEMO_CODE= '3007诊断.frm' AND SHOW_IF = '是')
GROUP BY ContractsID,PRO_CODE
)C ON A.合同ID=C.合同ID
GROUP BY A.PRO_CODE 
order by CASE 
WHEN IFNULL(SUM(C.销售额),0) = 0 OR IFNULL(SUM(B.租金收入) ,0) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE SUM(B.租金收入) /SUM(C.销售额) END desc)aa
where 租售比>0

/* ApplicationName=DataGrip 2025.3.5 */ select
    so.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    ma.material_name                as material_name,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.amount,0))            as amount,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0))       as cost_amount,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)/(1+IFNULL(mr.deductible_rate,0)))       as 成本合计多链,
    SUM(ROUND(tt.成本未含税金额,2)) as 成本未含税金额,
    sum(IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)/(1+IFNULL(mr.deductible_rate,0))-ROUND(tt.成本未含税金额,2)) as 成本差异,
    mr.sale_rate                    as out_rate,
    mr.deductible_rate              as in_rate
from scm_stock_out_detail_rela sod
inner join scm_stock_out_rela so on sod.stock_out_id = so.stock_out_id and sod.app_id = so.app_id
left join base_material_rela ma on sod.material_id = ma.material_id and ma.app_id = sod.app_id
left join base_material_type_rela mat on ma.material_type_id = mat.material_type_id and mat.app_id = sod.app_id
left join yw_material_rate mr on ma.material_id = mr.material_id
left join yw_org_company o on o.org_id = so.sale_org_id
left join yw_org_company oo on oo.org_id = so.purchase_org_id
right join (
    select sum(ac.成本未含税金额) as 成本未含税金额, ac.货品ID as 货品ID, ac.单号, ac.org_name, ac.supplier_name from aa_cost_detail ac
                group by ac.货品ID, ac.org_name, ac.supplier_name, ac.单号
) tt on o.org_name = tt.supplier_name and oo.org_name = tt.org_name
                  and ma.third_material_id = tt.货品ID and tt.单号 = so.bill_no
where so.is_del = 0
    and sod.is_del = 0
    and so.total_price > 0
    and COALESCE(so.syscomment, '') NOT LIKE '%KD%'
and so.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and so.bill_type in ('psck')
and (so.audit_date between '2026-02-01T00:00' and '2026-02-28T23:59:59')
and so.sale_org_id = '101305873741119723'
and so.bill_status = 'ysh'
and so.purchase_org_id NOT IN (select
        o.org_id
    from yw_org_company o
    where o.is_del = 0 and o.third_company_id in (select b.third_company_id from yw_org_company b where b.org_id = so.sale_org_id)
    and o.org_id != so.sale_org_id and (o.is_independent_settlement = 1 or o.org_type = 3))
#     and so.bill_no = 'PC202602232313'
    group by so.bill_no

select count(1)  from ( SELECT t.distribute_code as `分销商编码`,
etp.etp_name as `分销商名称`,
t.complete_time 核销月份,
sum(t.dis_settle_amount+t.dis_adjustment_amount-t.dis_abnormal_amount) as `应收金额`,
sum(t.dis_settle_amount+t.dis_adjustment_amount-t.dis_abnormal_amount)-sum(t.received_paid_amount) as `未收金额`,
sum(t.received_paid_amount) as `已收金额`
FROM
(
SELECT od.distribute_code,
date_format(d.complete_time,'%Y-%m') complete_time,
sum(d.dis_settle_amount) dis_settle_amount,
SUM(if(d.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (d.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),d.dis_settle_amount,0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount
FROM stat.ord_shopping_order_item_detail d 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.main_order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
WHERE d.complete_time is not null and d.order_type in ('200017001', '200024001')
and od.distribute_code is not null
 and  1=1 
 and  1=1 
group by od.distribute_code,date_format(d.complete_time,'%Y-%m')
UNION ALL
SELECT od.distribute_code,
date_format(d.complete_time,'%Y-%m') complete_time,
sum(d.dis_settle_amount) dis_settle_amount,
SUM(if(d.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (d.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),d.dis_settle_amount,0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount
FROM stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order_item d 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.main_order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
WHERE d.complete_time is not null and  d.deliver_type in (1, 2)  and d.product_type=1
and od.distribute_code is not null
 and  1=1 
 and  1=1 
group by od.distribute_code,date_format(d.complete_time,'%Y-%m')
UNION ALL
SELECT od.distribute_code,
date_format(d.use_time,'%Y-%m') complete_time,
sum(d.dis_settle_amount) dis_settle_amount,
SUM(if(d.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (od.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),d.dis_settle_amount,0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount
FROM sunbox.coupon_virtual_product d 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
WHERE d.use_time is not null
and od.distribute_code is not null
 and  1=1 
 and  1=1 
group by od.distribute_code,date_format(d.use_time,'%Y-%m')
UNION ALL
SELECT ad.distribute_code,
date_format(ad.create_time,'%Y-%m') complete_time,
0 dis_settle_amount,
sum(if(ad.contract_type =2 and ((s.credit=2 and s.state=7) or (s.credit !=2 and s.state=5)),(IFNULL(ad.after_settle_amount,0)-IFNULL(ad.settle_amount,0)),0)) received_paid_amount,
sum((IFNULL(ad.after_settle_amount,0)-IFNULL(ad.settle_amount,0))) dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount
FROM sunbox.base_etp_settle_adjustment ad
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on ad.order_id=od.id
LEFT JOIN sunbox.base_etp_settle_statement s on ad.statement_id=s.id
WHERE ad.create_time is not null 
and ad.contract_type =2
and ad.distribute_code is not null
and ad.source=1
 and  1=1 
 and  1=1 
group by  ad.distribute_code,date_format(ad.create_time,'%Y-%m')
UNION ALL
SELECT d.distribute_code,
date_format(d.refund_approvel_time,'%Y-%m') complete_time,
0 dis_settle_amount,
SUM(if(od.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (d.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),0-d.refund_amount,0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
sum(IFNULL(d.refund_amount,0)) dis_abnormal_amount
FROM sunbox.ord_abnormal_order d
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
WHERE d.refund_approvel_time is not null 
and d.refund_approvel_state=2
and d.distribute_code is not null
 and  1=1 
 and  1=1 
group by d.distribute_code,date_format(d.refund_approvel_time,'%Y-%m')
)t LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_enterprise etp on t.distribute_code = etp.etp_ou_code
where etp.etp_name is not null
group by t.distribute_code,etp.etp_name,t.complete_time
order by t.complete_time ) tmp_group

SELECT
    tms.create_datetime,
    pod.scan_datetime,
    tms.id as manifest_id,
    bhi.category_type, -- 代理
    tms.jobno,
    tms.dest_name,
    tms.fba_no,
    tms.refno,
    ext.amazon_sip,
    -- tmc.child_jobno,
    boh.delivery_type,
    las.aws_receipt_day,
    las.aws_declaration_day,
    las.aws_warehouse_day,
    las.aws_delivery_day,
    las.aws_clearance_day,
    ROUND(
    (IFNULL(las.aws_shipment_day, 0) + IFNULL(las.aws_shipment_two_day, 0)) /
    NULLIF(
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_shipment_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_shipment_two_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    0)
    ) AS aws_shipment_day,
    
    ROUND(
    (IFNULL(las.aws_arrive_day, 0) + IFNULL(las.aws_arrive_two_day, 0) + IFNULL(las.aws_arrive_three_day, 0)) /
    NULLIF(
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_arrive_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_arrive_two_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_arrive_three_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    0)
    ) AS aws_arrive_day,
    
    ROUND(
    (IFNULL(las.aws_signfor_day, 0) + IFNULL(las.aws_signfor_two_day, 0)) /
    NULLIF(
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_signfor_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN IFNULL(las.aws_signfor_two_day, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    0)
    ) AS aws_signfor_day
    FROM
        (
        select 
        id,
        jobno,
        dest_name,
        fba_no,
        refno,
        hub_out_id,
        create_datetime,
        nb_channel_hub_id
        from tms_manifest
        where isdel = 0
        ) tms
        left join bas_hub_in bhi on bhi.id = tms.nb_channel_hub_id and bhi.isdel =0 -- 代理
        inner join (select amazon_sip,manifest_id from tms_manifest_ext where isdel=0 and amazon_push =2 )ext on tms.id = ext.manifest_id 
        LEFT JOIN (
        select 
        manifest_id,
        aws_receipt_day,
        aws_declaration_day,
        aws_warehouse_day,
        aws_delivery_day,
        aws_clearance_day,
        aws_shipment_day,
        aws_shipment_two_day,
        aws_arrive_day,
        aws_arrive_two_day,
        aws_arrive_three_day,
        aws_signfor_day,
        aws_signfor_two_day
        from
        tms_manifest_last_state
        where isdel=0) las ON tms.id = las.manifest_id  
        left join (select id,delivery_type from bas_hub_out where isdel=0)boh on tms.hub_out_id = boh.id 
        -- left join (select no,child_jobno from tms_manifest_child where isdel=0)tmc on tmc.no = tms.refno
        inner join(
        select 
        manifest_id,
        scan_datetime,
        create_datetime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (partition BY manifest_id order by scan_datetime DESC) as row_num
        from tms_manifest_pod 
        where isdel = 0 and scan_code in ('HWYQS','YHC') 
        AND create_datetime >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND create_datetime <= '2026-02-28 23:59:59'  
        and manifest_type =1
        ) pod on pod.manifest_id = tms.id and pod.row_num =1
        left join bis_mbr_dwd md on md.jobno = tms.jobno and pod.scan_datetime = md.scan_datetime
        and md.aws_signfor_day = las.aws_signfor_day 
        and md.aws_receipt_day = las.aws_receipt_day
        and md.aws_shipment_day = las.aws_shipment_day
        and md.aws_arrive_day = las.aws_arrive_day
        and md.amazon_sip = ext.amazon_sip
        and md.aws_clearance_day = las.aws_clearance_day
		where md.jobno is null

SELECT
            i.id,
            i.inventory_no,
            i.depart_time,
            i.service_charge,
            i.state,
            i.driver_name,
            i.driver_phone,
            i.carrier_nature,
            i.truck_license_plate,
            i.update_time,
            (
            SELECT
            o.start_station_id
            FROM
            business_order o
            LEFT JOIN business_inventory_order io ON io.order_id = o.id
            WHERE
            io.inventory_id = i.id
            LIMIT 1
            ) startStationId,
            i.depart_station_id,
            i.depart_station_name,
            ( SELECT real_name FROM sys_user WHERE id = i.create_by ) departStationUserName,
            ( SELECT mobile FROM sys_user WHERE id = i.create_by ) departStationUserPhone,
            i.fee_petrol,
            i.close_station_id,
            i.close_station_name
        FROM
            business_inventory i
            LEFT JOIN business_inventory_transfer it ON it.inventory_id = i.id
         WHERE  i.depart_station_id != '6e148e14faac4022b6b2a9b513fb7092'
                            
                                
                                
                                
                                    and  EXISTS ( select id
                                    from business_inventory_transfer where inventory_id = i.id and station_id = '6e148e14faac4022b6b2a9b513fb7092' and transport_type = 1 and sort > 0
                                    )
                                    and ((SELECT
                                    o.to_station_id
                                    FROM
                                    business_order o
                                    LEFT JOIN business_inventory_order io ON io.order_id = o.id
                                    left join business_inventory_transfer_order ito on ito.order_id = o.id
                                    WHERE
                                    io.inventory_id = i.id and ito.inventory_transfer_id = it.id AND o.`status` = 4 limit 1) != '6e148e14faac4022b6b2a9b513fb7092'
                                    or (
                                    SELECT
                                    o.to_station_id
                                    FROM
                                    business_order o
                                    LEFT JOIN business_inventory_order io ON io.order_id = o.id
                                    LEFT JOIN business_inventory_transfer_order ito ON ito.order_id = o.id
                                    WHERE
                                    io.inventory_id = i.id
                                    AND ito.inventory_transfer_id = it.id
                                    AND o.`status` = 4
                                    LIMIT 1
                                    ) is null
                                    )
                                    and not EXISTS (SELECT
                                    o.id
                                    FROM
                                    business_order o
                                    LEFT JOIN business_inventory_order io ON io.order_id = o.id
                                    LEFT JOIN business_inventory_transfer_order ito ON ito.order_id = o.id
                                    left join business_inventory_transfer tr on tr.id = ito.inventory_transfer_id
                                    WHERE
                                    io.inventory_id = i.id and tr.station_id = '6e148e14faac4022b6b2a9b513fb7092' and tr.transport_type = 1 and tr.sort > 0 and o.`status` = 4 )
                                    and i.state in (1, 2, 3)
                                
                            
                            
                                and i.depart_station_id = '60bfb928f0184c6ba86cfb813a9949a7' 
        GROUP BY
            i.id
        ORDER BY
            i.depart_time DESC,
            i.update_time DESC LIMIT 0,10

    si.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    si.bill_type                    as bill_type,
    si.bill_date                    as bill_date,
    si.account_date                 as bill_create_time,
    si.bussiness_date               as bill_stock_time,
    si.audit_date                   as bill_audit_time,
    si.stock_total_money            as bill_amount,         -- 入库金额
    si.total_price                  as bill_cost_amount,    -- 采购金额
    case when si.bill_type = 'cgthd'
        then 'out'
        else 'in'
    end                             as stock_type,
    si.purchase_org_id              as in_org_id,
    si.sale_org_id                  as out_org_id,
    si.supplier_id                  as supplier_id,
    sb.settlement_no                as settlement_no,
    se.voucher_status               as voucher_status,
    se.reversal_voucher_status      as reversal_voucher_status
from scm_stock_in_rela si
left join yw_settlement_bill sb on si.bill_no = sb.bill_no and sb.is_del = 0
left join yw_settlement se on sb.settlement_id = se.settlement_id and se.is_del = 0
where si.is_del = 0
  -- and si.bill_status = 'ysh'
  and si.total_price > 0
  and COALESCE(si.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%KD%'
and si.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and si.bill_type in ('tprk')
and (si.audit_date between '2026-02-01 00:00:00' and '2026-02-28 23:59:59')
and si.purchase_org_id in ('101305873741119848')
and EXISTS (select 1 from yw_org_company oc where oc.org_id = si.sale_org_id and oc.org_type != 3 )
and sb.settlement_no is null
union all
 select
     so.stock_out_id                 as bill_id,
     so.bill_no                      as bill_no,
     so.bill_type                    as bill_type,
     so.bill_date                    as bill_date,
     so.account_date                 as bill_create_time,

     'out'                           as stock_type,
     so.purchase_org_id              as in_org_id,
     so.sale_org_id                  as out_org_id,
     '-1'                            as supplier_id,
     sb.settlement_no                as settlement_no,
     se.voucher_status               as voucher_status,
     se.reversal_voucher_status      as reversal_voucher_status
 from scm_stock_out_rela so
 left join yw_settlement_bill sb on so.bill_no = sb.bill_no and sb.is_del = 0
 left join yw_settlement se on sb.settlement_id = se.settlement_id and se.is_del = 0
 where so.is_del = 0
   -- and so.bill_status = 'ysh'
   and so.total_price > 0
and COALESCE(so.syscomment, '') not like '%KD%'
and so.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and so.bill_type in ('psck')
and (so.audit_date between '2026-02-01 00:00:00' and '2026-02-28 23:59:59')
and so.sale_org_id in ('101305873741119848')

SELECT
    CAST(CONCAT(hprh.payment_req_header_id, hprl.tax_rate) AS DECIMAL(9,2))*100 AS '拼接后ID',
    hprh.payment_req_header_id,
    hprh.payment_req_number,
    hprh.business_department,
    hprh.merchant_number,
    hprh.party_site_number,
    hprh.payment_amount,
    hprh.document_status,
    hprh.name,
    hprh.business_company_code,
    hprh.company_code,
    hprh.business_type_code,
    hprh.account_sheets_monthly,
    hprh.creation_date,
    hprh.applying_department,
    hprh.accounting_date,
    hprh.currency_code,
    hprh.bill_type,
    hprh.payment_code,
    hprh.reimburser,
    hprh.Reimbursement_department,
    hprh.contract_type AS contract_type_header,
    hprh.cost_recovery_method AS cost_recovery_method_header,
    hprl.tax_rate,
    hprl.detailed_items,
    hprl.contract_type,
    hprl.cost_recovery_type,
    hprh.source_system,

    SUM(hprl.tax_amount) AS '单据行同税率汇总税额',

    lird_sum.tax_c_y  AS '关联关系税额汇总C',
    lird_sum.tax_c_n  AS '非最后一张审批完成关联关系税额汇总C',
    lird_sum.tax_ny_y AS '关联关系税额汇总NY',
    lird_sum.tax_ny_n AS '非最后一张审批完成关联关系税额汇总NY'

FROM iscs_hsbm.hsbm_payment_req_headers hprh
JOIN iscs_hsbm.hsbm_payment_req_lines hprl ON hprl.payment_req_header_id = hprh.payment_req_header_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        relate_document_id,
        relate_document_type,
        invoice_tax_rate,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stop_recovery_flag = 'C' AND last_approved_doc_flag = 'Y' THEN relate_rate_amount END) AS tax_c_y,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stop_recovery_flag = 'C' AND last_approved_doc_flag = 'N' THEN relate_rate_amount END) AS tax_c_n,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stop_recovery_flag IN ('N','Y') AND last_approved_doc_flag = 'Y' THEN relate_rate_amount END) AS tax_ny_y,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stop_recovery_flag IN ('N','Y') AND last_approved_doc_flag = 'N' THEN relate_rate_amount END) AS tax_ny_n
    FROM
        iscs_hsbm.lsbm_invoice_relate_document
    GROUP BY
        relate_document_id, relate_document_type, invoice_tax_rate
) lird_sum 
   ON lird_sum.relate_document_id = hprh.payment_req_header_id AND lird_sum.relate_document_type = hprh.document_type AND lird_sum.invoice_tax_rate = hprl.tax_rate

WHERE
    hprh.bill_type LIKE '%INVOICE%' 
    AND hprh.document_type = 'Payment_Application' 
    AND hprl.bill_type='INVOICE' and hprh.business_type_code not IN('BT036','BT037')
    and ((hprh.business_type_code = 'BT074' and hprl.detailed_items in ('BT026207','BT026208','BT026222','BT026223','BT026224','BT026225','BT026226','BT026227','BT026228','BT026229','BT026230')) or hprh.business_type_code != 'BT074')
    AND hprh.document_status IN ('APPROVED', 'INVOICE_APPROVING' ,'DI_INVOICE_APPROVING','DI_INVOICE_APPROVING_BPM','REPAYAPPROVED') AND hprh.source_system NOT IN('IMP')
    
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM iscs_hsbm.hsbm_payment_req_lines l
      JOIN iscs_hsbm.lsbm_invoice_relate_document d
        ON d.relate_document_id = l.payment_req_header_id
        AND d.relate_document_type = hprh.document_type
        AND d.invoice_tax_rate = l.tax_rate
      WHERE l.payment_req_header_id = hprh.payment_req_header_id
        AND l.bill_type='INVOICE'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM iscs_hsbm.lsbm_invoice_relate_document x
            WHERE x.invoice_header_id = d.invoice_header_id
              AND x.invoice_tax_rate = d.invoice_tax_rate
              AND (x.last_approved_doc_flag IS NULL OR x.last_approved_doc_flag='Y')
        )
  )

GROUP BY
    hprh.payment_req_header_id,
    hprl.tax_rate

select
            bo.*,
            os.order_type orderType,
            os.remark orderTypeRemark,
            case when IFNULL(os.sync_status,'')='success' then 1 when IFNULL(v.order_id,'')!='' then 1 else 0 end sync_status,
            case when IFNULL(v1.order_id,'')!='' then 1 when IFNULL(v2.order_id,'')!='' then 2 when IFNULL(os.order_id,'')!='' then 3 else 0 end as order_status
        from bank_order bo
        left join dz_bm_order_sign os on os.order_id=bo.order_id
        left join (select distinct order_id from dz_bm_order_sync) v on v.order_id=bo.order_id
        left join (select distinct order_id from dz_bm_shop_expect where order_id is not null) v1 on v1.order_id=bo.order_id
        left join (select distinct order_id from dz_bm_order_split) v2 on v2.order_id=bo.order_id
         
        where bo.is_del=0

          and bo.trans_time >='2026-03-01 00:00:00' 
          and bo.trans_time <= '2026-03-11 23:59:59' 

         
         

         
         
         
          and bo.remark like '%商家提现%' 

         

         
             
             and not exists (select 1 from dz_bm_match_detail where real_order_id = bo.order_id) 
         
         
             
                and os.order_type is null
             
             
         
         
          and bo.customer_name like '%抖音%' 
         

     
        order by trans_time
        limit 0,100

select
      r.id refundId,
	  r.refund_num,
	  oi.order_item_num,
	  s.name studentName,
	  s.number studentNumber,
	  a.sign_type,
	  (select t.name from uc_staff t where t.user_id=o.sign_order_user_id) signOrderUserName,
	  r.type,
	  ri.refund_course_type,
	  p1.type AS product_type,
	  (select t.name from bd_course_type t where t.id=a.course_type_id) courseTypeName,
	  IF( oi.product_type = 'course', p.`name`, p1.`name` ) AS product_name,
	  a.class_year_name,
	  a.class_semester_name,
	  ( SELECT t.name FROM bd_class_schedule t WHERE t.id = c.class_schedule_id ) AS classScheduleName,
	  ( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_grade t WHERE t.id = a.grade_id ) AS grade_name,
	  ( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_subject t WHERE t.id = a.subject_id ) AS subject_name,
	  ( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_campus t WHERE t.id = c.campus_id ) AS campus_name,
	  u.name teacherName,
	  u.job_no teacherJobNo,
	  oi.practical_amount,
	  if(oi.product_type in ('course','classhour'),ri.refund_count/pc.single_class_hour,null) refundTimesNum,
	  ( SELECT t.nickname FROM uc_user t WHERE t.id = r.apply_refund_user_id ) AS applyRefundUserName,
	  DATE_FORMAT(r.apply_refund_time,'%Y-%m-%d') apply_refund_time,
	  ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(rv.refund_method) FROM trade_refund_record_v2 rv WHERE rv.deleted = 0 AND rv.refund_id = r.id order by rv.refund_method desc) AS refund_method,
	  ri.real_refund_amount,
	  r.refund_status,
	  ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rv.real_refund_time,'%Y-%m-%d') FROM trade_refund_record_v2 rv WHERE rv.deleted = 0 AND rv.refund_id = r.id order by rv.id desc limit 1) AS real_refund_time,
	  ( SELECT t.nickname FROM trade_refund_record_v2 rv 
	    left join uc_user t on t.id=rv.operate_refund_user_id
	    WHERE rv.deleted = 0 AND rv.refund_id = r.id order by rv.id desc limit 1 
	  ) AS operateRefundUserName,
	  ( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_refund_reason t WHERE t.id = r.refund_reason_id ) AS refund_reason_name,
	  r.description
	from trade_refund_item ri
	LEFT JOIN trade_refund r ON r.id = ri.refund_id
	LEFT JOIN trade_refund_class rc ON rc.refund_item_id = ri.id
	LEFT JOIN trade_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.order_item_id
	LEFT JOIN trade_order o on o.id=oi.order_id
	LEFT JOIN trade_order_course_item a on a.order_item_id=oi.id
	LEFT JOIN rc_student s on s.id=o.student_id
	LEFT JOIN pc_class c ON c.id = rc.refund_class_id
	LEFT JOIN pc_course pc ON c.course_id = pc.id
	LEFT JOIN trade_product p ON p.id = pc.product_id
	LEFT JOIN uc_staff u on u.user_id=c.teacher_id
	LEFT JOIN trade_product p1 ON p1.id = oi.product_id
	 WHERE ri.deleted = 0 and o.business_id = 4
	  AND r.apply_refund_time >= '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
	  
	  
	  
	  
	    and r.refund_status in 
	    (
	      'success'
	    )  
	order by r.real_refund_time desc,r.refund_num desc LIMIT 10

select * from
        (
        select sr.pos_no,sr.rec_id,sr.create_time,sr.status_,sr.finish_time,
        srp.pay_lists,
        srg.good_lists,
        sr.vip_card_id as cardid,
        sr.vip_mobile as mobile,
        sr.point_ as point,
        srg.contractno as dept_code,
        srg.dept_code as shopid,
        srg.brandName as dept_name,
        case sr.type_
        when 0 then '销售'
        when 1 then '负销售'
        when 2 then '退货'
        when 3 then '补录'
        when 4 then '销售上报'
        end as source,
        PER.NAME as payname,
        srg.mallName as store_name,
        srg.mall as shop,
        ifnull(srp.amount,0)+ifnull(srgd.disc_amount,0) as amount,
        ifnull(srp.amount,0) as cash_amount,
        concat(sr.pos_no,sr.rec_id) order_id,
        ifnull(srgd.disc_amount,0) as disamount,
        payl.extra_ as extra,
        pos.PAYFREE_TERMINAL_NO as PAYFREE_TERMINAL_NO
        from pos_sale_rec sr
        LEFT JOIN erp_sys_pos as pos on sr.pos_no =pos.POSNO
        LEFT JOIN
        (select a.rec_id,a.pos_no,sum(a.amount) amount,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pt.name) pay_lists
        from pos_sale_rec_pay as a
        LEFT JOIN erp_sys_paytype as pt ON pt.id_=a.payment_id
        GROUP BY a.rec_id,a.pos_no) as srp on srp.rec_id=sr.rec_id and srp.pos_no=sr.pos_no
        LEFT JOIN erp_person_def PER ON(SR.CASHIER_ID =PER.id_)
        LEFT JOIN
        (select b.rec_id,b.pos_no,sum(b.disc_amount) as disc_amount FROM pos_sale_rec_good_disc as b GROUP BY
        b.rec_id,b.pos_no) as srgd on srgd.rec_id=sr.rec_id and srgd.pos_no=sr.pos_no
        LEFT JOIN
        (select srgt.rec_id,srgt.pos_no,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gt.NAME) good_lists,
                shop.id_ as dept_code,shop.BRAND_NAME as brandName,
                contract.mall,contract.MALL_NAME as mallName,contract.CONTRACTNO as contractno
        from pos_sale_rec_good as srgt
        LEFT JOIN erp_sys_goods as gt on srgt.good_id=gt.id_
        left join erp_contract as contract on contract.contractno = gt.CONTRACTNO
        left join erp_contract_shop as shop on shop.CONTRACTNO =contract.CONTRACTNO
        GROUP BY srgt.rec_id,srgt.pos_no) as srg on srg.rec_id=sr.rec_id and srg.pos_no=sr.pos_no
        left join (select pay.rec_id,pay.pos_no,pay.extra_
        from pos_sale_rec_paylist as pay

        GROUP BY pay.rec_id,pay.pos_no) as payl on payl.rec_id=sr.rec_id and payl.pos_no=sr.pos_no
        ) as a
        having 1=1
         
         
         
         
            and a.create_time >= '2026-03-07 00:00:00'
         
         
         
            and a.create_time < '2026-03-07 23:59:59'
         
         
         
         
            and a.amount >=272
         
         
            and a.amount <=272
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
        order by create_time desc

SELECT
			t.*
		FROM
		(
			SELECT
				o.student_id,
				s.`name` AS student_name,
				s.number AS student_no,
				o.business_id,
				( SELECT bu.`name` FROM bc_business bu WHERE bu.id = o.business_id ) AS business_name,
				oi.order_id,
				o.random_id AS order_random_id,
				o.order_num,
				( 
					( 
						SELECT COUNT(1) FROM trade_order_payment p1 
						WHERE p1.order_id = o.id 
						AND ( p1.payment_method_subtype IS NULL OR p1.payment_method_subtype = 1 ) 
					) = 0 
				) AS b2b_transfer,
				( 
					SELECT
						p1.account_id
					FROM trade_order_payment p1 
					WHERE p1.order_id = o.id 
					AND ( p1.payment_method_subtype IS NOT NULL OR p1.payment_method_subtype = 2 )
					LIMIT 1
				) AS account_id,
				oi.trace_id,
				oi.id AS order_item_id,
				oi.order_item_num AS order_item_num,
				oi.product_type,
				oi.product_code,
				oi.product_name,
				c.id AS class_id,
				c.`code` AS class_code,
				c.`name` AS class_name,
				( SELECT ca.`name` FROM bd_campus ca WHERE ca.id = c.campus_id ) AS campus_name,
				( SELECT u.nickname FROM uc_user u WHERE u.id = c.teacher_id ) AS teacher_name,
				c.begin_time as beginDate,
				c.end_time as endDate,
				DATE_FORMAT( c.begin_time, '%m-%d' ) AS begin_time,
				DATE_FORMAT( c.end_time, '%m-%d' ) AS end_time,
				ti.`name` AS timestep_name,
				DATE_FORMAT( ti.begin_time, '%H:%i' ) AS timestep_begin_time,
				DATE_FORMAT( ti.end_time, '%H:%i' ) AS timestep_end_time,
				c.study_frequency_type,
				c.`week`,
				ce.class_year_id,
				ce.class_semester_id,
				ce.course_system_id,
				csy.`name` AS course_system_name,
				csy.`code` AS course_system_code,
				ci.course_type_id,
				ci.course_series_id,
				ci.class_type_id,
				( SELECT y.`name` FROM bd_class_year y WHERE y.id = ce.class_year_id ) AS class_year_name,
				( SELECT se.`name` FROM bd_class_semester se WHERE se.id = ce.class_semester_id ) AS class_semester_name,
				( SELECT g.`name` FROM bd_grade g WHERE g.id = IF( oi.product_type = 'course', c.grade_id, ci.grade_id ) ) AS grade_name,
				( SELECT s.`name` FROM bd_subject s WHERE s.id = ci.subject_id ) AS subject_name,
				c.quota,
				( SELECT ct.`name` FROM bd_course_type ct WHERE ct.id = ce.course_type_id ) AS course_type_name,
				( SELECT cs.`name` FROM bd_class_schedule cs WHERE cs.id = c.class_schedule_id ) AS class_schedule_name,
				ce.lecture_type,
 				 
				( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pc_class_times ct WHERE ct.class_id = c.id AND ct.deleted = 0 AND ct.end_time <= NOW() ) as already_num,
 				 
				c.total_class_num,
				ce.single_class_hour,
				oi.content_quantity * oi.total_num / ce.single_class_hour AS buy_class_num,
				oi.content_quantity * oi.total_num AS buy_class_hour,
				( SELECT g.`name` FROM bd_grade g WHERE g.id = ce.grade_id ) AS grade_names,
				cr.expire_time,
				p.content,
				oi.content_quantity,
				oi.total_num,
				oi.practical_amount AS payment_amount,
				IFNULL(
					IF(
						oi.product_type IN ( 'course', 'classhour' ),
						( 
							SELECT 
								SUM( cc.class_consume_amount ) 
							FROM 
								sc_student_times st 
								LEFT JOIN pc_class_consume cc ON cc.id = (
									SELECT 
										id 
									FROM 
										pc_class_consume cc 
									WHERE 
										cc.deleted = 0
										AND cc.consume_type IN ( 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 )
										AND cc.consume_time > '2023-01-01 00:00:00' 
										AND cc.consume_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
										AND cc.class_trace_id = st.class_trace_id 
										AND cc.times_num = st.times_num
									ORDER BY 
										cc.consume_time DESC
									LIMIT 1
								)
							WHERE 
								cc.deleted = 0 
								AND cc.consume_type IN ( 1, 2, 3 )
								AND st.trade_status = 2
								AND st.trace_id = oi.trace_id
						),
						IF(
							oi.product_type IN ( 'service' ),
							(
								SELECT 
									SUM(sdr.service_fee) 
								FROM 
									sc_student_service_delivery_record sdr
									LEFT JOIN sc_student_service_delivery sd ON sd.id = sdr.sign_id
								WHERE 
									sdr.deleted = 0
									AND sdr.refund_status = 0
									AND sdr.deliver_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
									AND sd.trace_id = oi.trace_id
							),
							IF(
								oi.product_type IN ( 'textbook' ),
								(
									SELECT
										SUM( mri.amount )
									FROM 
										sc_student_material_record_item mri
									WHERE 
										mri.deleted = 0
										AND mri.trade_status IN ( 2 )
										AND mri.`status` = 4
										AND mri.create_time > '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
										AND mri.record_create_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
										AND mri.trace_id = oi.trace_id
								),
								0
							)
						)
					),
					0
				) AS consume_amount,
				IFNULL(
					IF(
						oi.product_type IN ( 'course', 'classhour' ),
						( 
							SELECT 
								SUM( cc.class_consume_amount )
							FROM 
								sc_student_times st 
								LEFT JOIN pc_class_consume cc ON cc.id = (
									SELECT 
										id
									FROM 
										pc_class_consume cc 
									WHERE 
										cc.deleted = 0
										AND cc.consume_type IN ( 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 )
										AND cc.consume_time > '2023-01-01 00:00:00' 
										AND cc.consume_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
										AND cc.class_trace_id = st.class_trace_id
										AND cc.times_num = st.times_num
									ORDER BY 
										cc.consume_time DESC
									LIMIT 1
								)
							WHERE 
								cc.deleted = 0 
								AND cc.consume_type IN ( 1, 2, 3 )
								AND st.trade_status = 2
								AND st.invoice_status = 0
								AND st.trace_id = oi.trace_id
						),
						IF(
							oi.product_type IN ( 'service' ),
							(
								SELECT
									SUM( sdr.service_fee )
								FROM 
									sc_student_service_delivery_record sdr
									LEFT JOIN sc_student_service_delivery sd ON sd.id = sdr.sign_id
								WHERE 
									sdr.deleted = 0
									AND sdr.refund_status = 0
									AND sdr.invoice_status = 0
									AND sdr.deliver_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
									AND sd.trace_id = oi.trace_id
							),
							IF(
								oi.product_type IN ( 'textbook' ),
								(
									SELECT
										SUM( mri.amount )
									FROM 
										sc_student_material_record_item mri
									WHERE 
										mri.deleted = 0
										AND mri.trade_status IN ( 2 )
										AND mri.`status` = 4
										AND mri.invoice_status = 0
										AND mri.create_time > '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
										AND mri.record_create_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
										AND mri.trace_id = oi.trace_id
								),
								0
							)
						)
					),
					0
				) AS invoice_amount,
				IFNULL(
					IF(
						oi.product_type IN ( 'course', 'classhour' ),
						( 
							SELECT 
								GROUP_CONCAT( st.id )
							FROM 
								sc_student_times st 
								LEFT JOIN pc_class_consume cc ON cc.id = (
									SELECT 
										id
									FROM 
										pc_class_consume cc 
									WHERE 
										cc.deleted = 0
										AND cc.consume_type IN ( 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 )
										AND cc.consume_time > '2023-01-01 00:00:00' 
										AND cc.consume_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
										AND cc.class_trace_id = st.class_trace_id
										AND cc.times_num = st.times_num
									ORDER BY 
										cc.consume_time DESC
									LIMIT 1
								)
							WHERE 
								cc.deleted = 0 
								AND cc.consume_type IN ( 1, 2, 3 )
								AND st.trade_status = 2
								AND st.invoice_status = 0
								AND st.trace_id = oi.trace_id
						),
						IF(
							oi.product_type IN ( 'service' ),
							(
								SELECT
									GROUP_CONCAT( sdr.id )
								FROM 
									sc_student_service_delivery_record sdr
									LEFT JOIN sc_student_service_delivery sd ON sd.id = sdr.sign_id
								WHERE 
									sdr.deleted = 0
									AND sdr.refund_status = 0
									AND sdr.invoice_status = 0
									AND sdr.deliver_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
									AND sd.trace_id = oi.trace_id
							),
							IF(
								oi.product_type IN ( 'textbook' ),
								(
									SELECT
										GROUP_CONCAT( mri.id )
									FROM 
										sc_student_material_record_item mri
									WHERE 
										mri.deleted = 0
										AND mri.trade_status IN ( 2 )
										AND mri.`status` = 4
										AND mri.invoice_status = 0
										AND mri.create_time > '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
										AND mri.record_create_time >= '2025-03-07 00:00:00'
										AND mri.trace_id = oi.trace_id
								),
								''
							)
						)
					),
					''
				) AS invoice_times_id
			FROM
				trade_order_item oi
				LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id
				LEFT JOIN rc_student s ON s.id = o.student_id
				LEFT JOIN trade_product p ON p.id = oi.product_id
				LEFT JOIN trade_order_course_item ci ON ci.order_item_id = oi.id AND oi.product_type IN ( 'course', 'classhour' )
				LEFT JOIN pc_course ce ON ce.id = ci.course_id
				LEFT JOIN pc_course_system csy ON csy.id = ce.course_system_id
				LEFT JOIN pc_class c ON c.id = ci.class_id
				LEFT JOIN bd_class_schedule cs ON cs.id = c.class_schedule_id
				LEFT JOIN bd_timestep ti ON ti.id = c.timestep_id
				LEFT JOIN sc_student_course_record cr ON cr.trace_id = oi.trace_id AND oi.product_type = 'classhour'
			WHERE
				oi.deleted = 0 
				AND o.order_status = 1 
				AND oi.product_type IN ( 'course', 'classhour', 'service', 'textbook' )
			 
				AND o.business_id = 4
			 
			 
			 
				AND o.student_id = 72152
			 
			 
			 
				AND oi.product_type = 'classhour'
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			 
			GROUP BY
				oi.id
			ORDER BY 
				o.id DESC,
				oi.order_package_id ASC,
				oi.id ASC
		) t
	 
		WHERE
			t.invoice_amount > 0 LIMIT 10
