SELECT t.* FROM (
        select
    si.stock_in_id                  as bill_id,             -- 单据基础信息
    si.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    sid.stock_in_detail_id          as bill_detail_id,
    si.bill_type                    as bill_type,
    si.bill_date                    as bill_date,
    si.account_date                 as bill_create_time,
    si.bussiness_date               as bill_stock_time,
    si.audit_date                   as bill_audit_time,
    case when si.bill_type = 'cgthd'
        then 'out'
        else 'in'
    end                             as stock_type,
    si.purchase_org_id              as in_org_id,           -- 收货组织
    si.sale_org_id                  as out_org_id,          -- 出货组织
    si.supplier_id                  as supplier_id,
    sid.material_id                 as material_id,
    ma.third_material_id            as third_material_id,
    ma.material_name                as material_name,
    ma.material_type_id             as material_type_id,
    mat.material_type_name          as material_type_name,
    sid.material_desc               as material_desc,
    sid.stock_in_unit_id            as stock_unit_name,
    case when si.bill_type = 'tprk'
        then sid.retreat_num
        else sid.actual_num
    end                             as num,
    IFNULL(sid.price,0)             as price,
    IFNULL(sid.amount,0)            as amount,
    IFNULL(sid.no_tax_amount,0)     as no_tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sid.tax_amount, 0)       as tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sid.tax,0)               as tax,
    IFNULL(sid.purchase_price,0)            as cost_price,
    IFNULL(sid.purchase_no_tax_price,0)     as cost_no_tax_price,
    IFNULL(sid.purchase_amount,0)           as cost_amount,
    IFNULL(sid.purchase_no_tax_amount,0)    as cost_no_tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sid.purchase_tax_amount,0)       as cost_tax_amount,
    IFNULL(si.stock_total_money,0)  as bill_amount,         -- 入库金额
    IFNULL(si.total_price,0)        as bill_cost_amount,    -- 采购金额
    IFNULL(sid.net_weight,0)        as net_weight,
    IFNULL(sid.total_weight,0)      as total_weight,
    si.stock_org_id                 as supplier_stock_org_id,
    si.sale_stock_org_id            as org_stock_org_id,
    (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sib.batch_id)
        FROM scm_stock_in_batch_rela sib
        WHERE sib.app_id = sid.app_id
          AND sib.stock_in_id = sid.stock_in_id
          AND sib.stock_in_detail_id = sid.stock_in_detail_id
          AND sib.bill_type = sid.bill_type
     ) AS batch_ids,
    mr.sale_rate                    as out_rate,
    mr.deductible_rate              as in_rate
from scm_stock_in_detail_rela sid
inner join scm_stock_in_rela si on sid.stock_in_id = si.stock_in_id and sid.app_id = si.app_id
left join base_material_rela ma on sid.material_id = ma.material_id and ma.app_id = sid.app_id
left join base_material_type_rela mat on ma.material_type_id = mat.material_type_id and mat.app_id = sid.app_id
left join yw_material_rate mr on ma.material_id = mr.material_id
where si.is_del = 0
    and sid.is_del = 0
    and COALESCE(si.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%KD%'
and (si.total_price > 0 or si.stock_total_money > 0) 
and si.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and si.bill_type in ('tprk')
and (si.audit_date between '2026-02-01 00:00:00' and '2026-02-28 23:59:59')
and si.purchase_org_id = '101305873741119848'
and si.sale_org_id NOT IN (select
        o.org_id
    from yw_org_company o
    where o.is_del = 0 and o.third_company_id in (select b.third_company_id from yw_org_company b where b.org_id = si.purchase_org_id)
    and o.org_id != si.purchase_org_id and (o.is_independent_settlement = 1 or o.org_type = 3))
union all
select
    so.stock_out_id                 as bill_id,
    so.bill_no                      as bill_no,
    sod.out_stock_detail_id         as bill_detail_id,
    so.bill_type                    as bill_type,
    so.bill_date                    as bill_date,
    so.account_date                 as bill_create_time,
    so.bussiness_date               as bill_stock_time,
    so.audit_date                   as bill_audit_time,
    'out'                           as stock_type,
    so.purchase_org_id              as in_org_id,               -- 出货组织
    so.sale_org_id                  as out_org_id,              -- 出货组织
    null                            as supplier_id,
    sod.material_id                 as material_id,
    ma.third_material_id            as third_material_id,
    ma.material_name                as material_name,
    ma.material_type_id             as material_type_id,
    mat.material_type_name          as material_type_name,
    sod.material_desc               as material_desc,
    sod.stock_out_unit_id           as stock_unit_name,
    IFNULL(sod.send_num,0)          as num,
    IFNULL(sod.price,0)             as price,
    IFNULL(sod.amount,0)            as amount,
    IFNULL(sod.no_tax_out_amount,0) as no_tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sod.tax_out_amount,0)    as tax_amount,
    IFNULL(sod.tax,0)               as tax,
    IFNULL(sod.cost_price,0)        as cost_price,
    IFNULL(sod.cost_no_tax_price,0) as cost_no_tax_price,
    IFNULL(sod.cost_amount,0)       as cost_amount,

left join base_material_type_rela mat on ma.material_type_id = mat.material_type_id and mat.app_id = sod.app_id
left join yw_material_rate mr on ma.material_id = mr.material_id
where so.is_del = 0

    and COALESCE(so.syscomment, '') NOT LIKE '%KD%'
and (so.total_price > 0 or so.cost_total_price > 0) 
and so.app_id = 'job-gongyinglian'
and so.bill_type in ('psck')
and (so.audit_date between '2026-02-01 00:00:00' and '2026-02-28 23:59:59')

and so.bill_status = 'ysh'
and so.purchase_org_id NOT IN (select
        o.org_id
    from yw_org_company o
    where o.is_del = 0 and o.third_company_id in (select b.third_company_id from yw_org_company b where b.org_id = so.sale_org_id)

SELECT
B.mall_bi_id,
A.member_id,
A.shop_id,
A.mall_id,
A.created_at,
A.`change`,
A.origin,
A.type,
A.id,
TradeRelationName1,
FloorCode,
ContractsCode,
BrandName,
CustomerName,
A.origin_item_id,
C.paid_amount
FROM
(SELECT
member_id,
shop_id,
A.mall_id,
created_at,
`change`,
origin,
type,
A.id,
IFNULL(TradeRelationName1, '其他') AS TradeRelationName1,
IFNULL(FloorCode, '其他') AS FloorCode,
ContractsCode,
BrandName,
CustomerName,
 origin_item_id
FROM
(
SELECT
member_id,
shop_id,
A.mall_id,
created_at,
`change`,
origin,
type,
B.id,
B.third_id,
  origin_item_id
FROM
(
SELECT 
member_id,
shop_id,
mall_id,
DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
`change`,
origin,
type,
origin_item_id
FROM
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_POINTS
WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND created_at < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND origin IN ('无感积分-支付宝', '无感积分-微信', '购物积分-小程序收银', '购物积分-小票上传', '线上消费奖励','服务台记录','消费送积分-CRM同步')
) A
LEFT JOIN
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_BHG_SYNC_SHOPS B -- 关联赢商合同表  获取租约号
ON A.shop_id = B.id AND A.mall_id = B.mall_id
) A
LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT
TradeRelationName1,
FloorCode,
ContractsCode,
BrandName,
CustomerName
FROM
TB_DW_NEW_CONTRACTS  -- 关联业态表 获取业态，楼层，品牌，名称
) B
ON A.third_id = B.ContractsCode
) A
LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT 
mall_id, 
mall_bi_id 
FROM 
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_MALL_MAP -- 关联维度表获取bi_id
) B
ON A.mall_id = B.mall_id
LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT
*
FROM
TB_ODS_NEW_HY_ORDERS
) C
ON A.origin_item_id = C.id

SELECT
			d.id,
			a.class_id,
			a.num AS times_num,
			a.`status` AS course_status,
			a.begin_time AS begin_date,
			a.end_time AS end_date,
			a.begin_time AS begin_time,
			a.end_time AS end_time,
			a.end_time AS class_date,
			a.teacher_id,
			a.classroom_id AS times_num_classroom_id,
			a.`week`,
			e.phone_encrypt AS studentPhoneEncrypt,
			e.`name` AS student_name,
			e.number AS student_number,
			c.`name`,
			c.`code`,
			c.quota,
			ps.quota AS class_quota,
			c.business_id,
			c.campus_id,
			c.class_type,
			c.single_class_hour,
			c.total_class_num,
			( c.single_class_hour * c.total_class_num ) AS total_class_hours,
			d.daily_archive_status,
			d.month_archive_status,
			d.month_archive_time,
			d.attend_status,
			d.attend_check,
			d.attend_time,
			d.is_need_connection,
			d.trade_status,
			d.transfer_status,
			d.makeup_status,
			d.student_id,
			d.create_uid,
			d.connection_status AS connect_status,
			d.not_yet_reason,
			( 
				SELECT 
					ut.nickname 
				FROM 
					rc_customer_allocation t 
					LEFT JOIN uc_user ut ON ut.id = t.follow_person_id 
				WHERE 
					t.follow_student_id = d.student_id 
					AND t.follow_business_id = c.business_id 
					AND t.deleted = 0 
				ORDER BY 
					t.id DESC 
				LIMIT 1 
			) AS edu_admin_name,
			g.`name` AS classroom_name,
			h.`name` AS timestep_name,
			ps.class_hour_duration AS minutes,
			c.grade_id,
			( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_grade t WHERE t.id = c.grade_id ) AS grade_name,
			k.nickname AS month_archive_user_name,
			ps.subject_id,
			( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_subject t WHERE t.id = ps.subject_id ) AS subject_name,
			r.refund_status,
			(
				CASE
					WHEN d.class_time_label_type = 0 THEN '正常课次' 
					WHEN d.class_time_label_type = 1 THEN '0元课' 
					WHEN d.class_time_label_type = 2 THEN '外接非0元' 
				END
			) AS class_time_label_type_name,
			IF( d.trade_status = 3, '是', '否' ) AS is_refund,
			( SELECT t.`name` FROM bd_course_type t WHERE t.id = ps.course_type_id ) AS course_type_name,
			gs.unit_price AS course_unit_price,
			( SELECT bc.`name` FROM bd_campus bc INNER JOIN bd_classroom bm ON bc.id = bm.campus_id WHERE bm.id = a.classroom_id ) AS times_num_campus_name,
			( SELECT `name` FROM bd_classroom t WHERE t.id = a.classroom_id ) AS times_num_classroom_name,
			s.job_no,
			s.`name` AS teacher_name,
			( SELECT t.`name` FROM bc_business t WHERE t.id = c.business_id ) AS business_name
		FROM
			sc_student_times d
			INNER JOIN pc_class_times a ON a.deleted = 0 AND a.class_id = d.class_id AND a.num = d.times_num
			INNER JOIN pc_class c ON a.class_id = c.id
			LEFT JOIN pc_course ps ON c.course_id = ps.id
			LEFT JOIN rc_student e ON d.student_id = e.id
			LEFT JOIN bd_classroom g ON a.classroom_id = g.id
			LEFT JOIN bd_timestep h ON a.timestep_id = h.id
			LEFT JOIN uc_user k ON d.month_archive_uid = k.id
			LEFT JOIN trade_refund r ON r.id = d.refund_id
			LEFT JOIN trade_goods gs ON gs.product_id = c.product_id
			LEFT JOIN uc_staff s ON s.user_id = a.teacher_id 
		WHERE
			d.deleted = 0 
			AND a.close_class_type = 0 
			AND a.`status` != 'RELEASE' 
			AND ( d.trade_status, d.attend_status ) IN (
				( 2, 0 ),
				( 2, 1 ),
				( 2, 2 ),
				( 3, 0 ),
				( 3, 1 ),
				( 4, 0 ),
				( 4, 1 ),
				( 4, 2 ) 
			)
         
            AND d.month_archive_status = 1
         
         
         
            AND d.month_archive_time >= '2026-02-23 00:00:00'
         
         
            AND d.month_archive_time <= '2026-02-23 23:59:59'
         
         
            AND c.business_id = '1'
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
		ORDER BY
			a.begin_time DESC,
			a.teacher_id ASC LIMIT 50000,5000

        FROM
        (
        SELECT
         
         
            (
            SELECT
            COUNT( DISTINCT sc.student_id, sc.class_id )
            FROM
            sc_student_class_record sc
            JOIN (SELECT max(scr.operate_time) as max_operation_time, scr.id,scr.class_id,student_id FROM sc_student_class_record scr
            WHERE
            scr.deleted = 0
            AND '2026-03-01 23:59:59' >= scr.operate_time
            GROUP BY scr.class_id,scr.student_id)scr
            ON sc.operate_time = scr.max_operation_time and scr.class_id = sc.class_id and sc.student_id = scr.student_id
            WHERE
            sc.deleted = 0
            AND sc.join_type IN (1,2)
            AND sc.class_id = t1.id
            )studyNum,
         
        if((ol.status is null and t1.class_mode=1
         
            and '2026-03-01 23:59:59' >= t1.create_time

        or (ol.status=2 and t1.class_mode=1

        ,t1.quota,0) quota1,
        t2.quota

        JOIN pc_course t2 ON t1.course_id = t2.id
        JOIN trade_goods_sale_mgr t3 on t3.spec_id=t1.id and t3.deleted=false

from
-- 昨日交易笔数
(SELECT 
mall_bi_id,
created_at,
left(created_at,7) as created_at_ymonth,
COUNT(member_id) AS spend_count_day
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER 
WHERE created_at = '2026-02-28'
-- 按照时间门店分组
group by mall_bi_id,created_at
) A
left join 
(SELECT 
a.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
a.created_at as created_at,
left(a.created_at,7) as created_ymonth,
COUNT(a.member_id) AS spend_count_day_GC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER a
left join 
-- 获取卡类型
(select member_id, member_level_id from bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER where  member_level_id='406') b
on a.member_id=b.member_id
WHERE a.created_at  = '2026-02-28'
and b.member_level_id is not null -- 剔除非金卡会员
-- 按照时间门店分组
group by a.mall_bi_id,a.created_at
) B
on A.mall_bi_id = B.mall_bi_id and A.created_at= B.created_at
left join 
(SELECT 
a.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,
a.created_at as created_at,
left(a.created_at,7) as created_ymonth,
COUNT(a.member_id) AS spend_count_day_SC
FROM bidb.TB_DW_NEW_HY_TRANSACTION_NUMBER a
left join 
-- 获取卡类型
(select member_id, member_level_id from bidb.TB_ODS_NEW_HY_COMPANY_MEMBER where  member_level_id='405') b

WHERE a.created_at = '2026-02-28'
and b.member_level_id is not null -- 剔除非银卡会员

group by a.mall_bi_id,a.created_at

left join 
(SELECT 
a.mall_bi_id as mall_bi_id,

left join jpaas_erp.duanzhu_feebill_apply a on (s.mall = a.MALL)
left join jpaas_erp.erp_duanzu_apply_feebill f on (a.id_ = f.ref_id_ and s.code = f.STORE)
left join jpaas_erp.erp_duanzu_apply_feebill_month m  on  (f.id_ =m.ref_id and m.start_date<=now() and m.end_date>now() )
left join jpaas_erp.erp_sys_feebills fe on (m.feebills_id = fe.id_ )
where s.`STATUS` !=0 and s.type !='HT'  
group by s.id_

left join jpaas_erp.erp_duanzu_apply_feebill_month m  on  (f.id_ =m.ref_id and m.start_date<=now() and m.end_date>now() )
left join jpaas_erp.erp_sys_feebills fe on (m.feebills_id = fe.id_ )
where s.`STATUS` !=0 and s.type !='HT'  
group by s.id_

        0 as task_pcs2,

        LEFT JOIN tms_manifest tm on tc.manifest_id = tm.id and tm.isdel = 0
        LEFT JOIN bas_stat st on tc.with_stat_id = st.id and st.isdel = 0
        left join tms_manifest_ext ext on ext.manifest_id = tm.id and ext.company_id = 40
        where tc.isdel = 0
        and tc.company_id = 40
        and tm.dispatch_audit_time between '2025-09-12 10:26:11.0' and '2026-03-11 10:26:11.0'
        and tc.manifest_transport_id is null
        and tc.delivery_method in ('1', '2', '3')
        and (tc.dispatch_type = '2' and tc.delivery_method = '2')
         
         
         

        union all

        select
        DATE_FORMAT(tm.dispatch_audit_time, '%Y/%m') AS date_month,
        0 as task_pcs1,
        0 as task_pcs2,
        ifnull(tc.pcs,0) as task_pcs3,

        from tms_car_task tc
        LEFT JOIN tms_manifest tm on tc.manifest_id = tm.id and tm.isdel = 0
        LEFT JOIN bas_stat st on tc.with_stat_id = st.id and st.isdel = 0
        left join tms_manifest_ext ext on ext.manifest_id = tm.id and ext.company_id = 40

        and tc.manifest_transport_id is null
        and tc.delivery_method in ('1', '2', '3')

        select
        DATE_FORMAT(tm.dispatch_audit_time, '%Y/%m') AS date_month,
        0 as task_pcs1,
        0 as task_pcs2,
        0 as task_pcs3,
        ifnull(tc.pcs,0) as task_pcs4

sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.deleted = false AND d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'special'), 0) specialDiscount, ifnull((SELECT sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.deleted = false AND d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'coupon'), 0) couponDiscount, ifnull((SELECT sum(d.discount_amount) FROM trade_order_item_discount d WHERE d.order_item_id = toi.id AND d.type = 'student'), 0) studentDiscount, toi.discount_total_amount AS discountTotalAmount, toi.payable_amount AS payableAmount, toi.practical_amount AS practicalAmount, (toi.payable_amount - toi.act_deduct_amount - toi.ct_deduct_amount) AS actualPaymentAmount, e.order_num AS orderNum, e.order_status AS orderStatus, e.pay_create_time AS payCreateTime, e.create_time AS orderCreateTime, b.name AS productName, b.code AS productCode, b.type AS productType, c.NAME AS goodsName, f.name AS studentName, f.number AS studentNo, i.name AS courseSystemName, j.name AS courseTypeName, k.name AS gradeName, l.name AS subjectName, n.name AS orderSource, o.nickname AS signOrderUserName, s.name AS businessName, e.type order_type, e.business_id, t1.* FROM trade_order_item toi LEFT JOIN trade_product b ON toi.product_id = b.id LEFT JOIN trade_goods c ON toi.goods_id = c.id LEFT JOIN pc_course d ON toi.product_id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN trade_order e ON toi.order_id = e.id LEFT JOIN rc_student f ON f.id = e.student_id LEFT JOIN pc_course_system i ON d.course_system_id = i.id LEFT JOIN bd_course_type j ON d.course_type_id = j.id LEFT JOIN bd_grade k ON d.grade_id = k.id LEFT JOIN bd_subject l ON d.subject_id = l.id LEFT JOIN uc_app n ON e.app_id = n.id LEFT JOIN uc_user o ON e.sign_order_user_id = o.id LEFT JOIN bc_business s ON e.business_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.description) pay_description, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.pay_type) pay_type, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d1.payment_method) payment_method, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT (CASE d1.payment_method_subtype WHEN 1 THEN '私对公转账' WHEN 2 THEN '公对公转账' ELSE '' END)) payment_method_subtype_name, MIN(d1.receipt_time) pay_receipt_time, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d2.nickname) d1.order_id FROM trade_order_payment d1 LEFT JOIN uc_user d2 ON d1.receipt_user_id = d2.id LEFT JOIN bd_campus d3 ON d3.id = d1.receipt_campus_id LEFT JOIN uc_app d4 ON d4.id = d1.app_id LEFT JOIN bd_account d5 ON d5.id = d1.account_id GROUP BY d1.order_id) t1 ON t1.order_id = e.id WHERE toi.deleted = 0 AND e.order_status = 1 AND e.business_id = 4 AND (f.number LIKE CONCAT('%', '符家豪', '%') OR 			LEFT JOIN sc_student_times d3 ON d3.class_id = d2.id

select
		toi.order_item_num,
		toi.total_num as totalNum,
		toi.unit_price as price,
		toi.total_amount as totalAmount,
		toi.act_deduct_amount,
		toi.ct_deduct_amount,
		toi.ct_deduct_diff_amount,
		ifnull((select sum(d.discount_amount) from trade_order_item_discount d where d.deleted=false and d.order_item_id=toi.id and d.type='special'),0) specialDiscount,
		ifnull((select sum(d.discount_amount) from trade_order_item_discount d where d.deleted=false and d.order_item_id=toi.id and d.type='coupon'),0) couponDiscount,
		ifnull((select sum(d.discount_amount) from trade_order_item_discount d where d.deleted=false and d.order_item_id=toi.id and d.type='activity'),0) activityDiscount,
		ifnull((select sum(d.discount_amount) from trade_order_item_discount d where d.deleted=false and d.order_item_id=toi.id and d.type='student'),0) studentDiscount,
		toi.discount_total_amount as discountTotalAmount,
		toi.payable_amount as payableAmount,
		toi.practical_amount as practicalAmount,
		(toi.payable_amount-toi.act_deduct_amount-toi.ct_deduct_amount) as actualPaymentAmount,
		e.order_num as orderNum,
		e.order_status as orderStatus,
		e.pay_create_time as payCreateTime,
		e.create_time as orderCreateTime,
		b.name AS productName,
		b.code as productCode,
		b.type as productType,
		c.NAME AS goodsName,
		f.name AS studentName,
		f.number AS studentNo,
		i.name as courseSystemName,
		j.name as courseTypeName,
		k.name as gradeName,
		l.name as subjectName,
		n.name as orderSource,
		o.nickname as signOrderUserName,
		s.name as businessName,
		e.type order_type,
		e.business_id,
		t1.*
		FROM trade_order_item toi
		LEFT JOIN trade_product b ON toi.product_id = b.id
		LEFT JOIN trade_goods c ON toi.goods_id = c.id
		LEFT JOIN pc_course d ON toi.product_id = d.product_id
		LEFT JOIN trade_order e ON toi.order_id = e.id
		LEFT JOIN rc_student f ON f.id = e.student_id
		LEFT JOIN pc_course_system i ON d.course_system_id = i.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_course_type j ON d.course_type_id = j.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_grade k ON d.grade_id = k.id
		LEFT JOIN bd_subject l ON d.subject_id = l.id
		LEFT JOIN uc_app n ON e.app_id = n.id
		LEFT JOIN uc_user o ON e.sign_order_user_id = o.id
		LEFT JOIN bc_business s ON e.business_id = s.id
		JOIN (
		SELECT
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d1.description ) pay_description,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d1.pay_type ) pay_type,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d1.payment_method ) payment_method,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT ( CASE d1.payment_method_subtype WHEN 1 THEN '私对公转账' WHEN 2 THEN '公对公转账' ELSE '' END ) ) payment_method_subtype_name,
			MIN( d1.receipt_time ) pay_receipt_time,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d2.nickname ) pay_receipt_user_name,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d3.NAME ) pay_receipt_campus_name,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d4.NAME ) pay_app_name,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d5.account_name ) pay_account_name,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d5.account ) pay_account,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d1.pay_portal ) pay_portal,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d1.pay_mch_id ) pay_mch_id,
			GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT d1.trade_no ) pay_trade_no,
			d1.order_id
		FROM
			trade_order_payment d1
			LEFT JOIN uc_user d2 ON d1.receipt_user_id = d2.id
			LEFT JOIN bd_campus d3 ON d3.id = d1.receipt_campus_id
			LEFT JOIN uc_app d4 ON d4.id = d1.app_id
			LEFT JOIN bd_account d5 ON d5.id = d1.account_id
		GROUP BY
			d1.order_id
		) t1 ON t1.order_id = e.id
		WHERE toi.deleted=0
		AND e.order_status = 1
		AND e.pay_create_time >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00'			
		AND e.pay_create_time <= '2026-02-21 23:59:59'		
		AND b.type != 'course'
		ORDER BY
			e.last_receipt_time DESC

SELECT 
t.etp_sup_ou_code as `供应商编码`,
etp.etp_name as `供应商名称`,
etp.etp_addr as `供应商所在区域`,
IFNULL(CONCAT(dis_etp.etp_name,'(',t.distribute_code,')'),'广西一键游旅游运营有限公司(1002001001)') as `分销商名称`,
sum(t.dis_settle_amount+t.dis_adjustment_amount-t.dis_abnormal_amount) as `应收金额`,
sum(t.received_paid_amount) as `已收金额`,
sum(t.settle_amount+t.adjustment_amount-t.abnormal_amount) as `应付金额`,
sum(t.paid_amount) as `已付金额`,
sum((t.dis_settle_amount+t.dis_adjustment_amount-t.dis_abnormal_amount)-(t.settle_amount+t.adjustment_amount-t.abnormal_amount)) as `利润`,
sum(t.coupon_amount) as `优惠券金额`
FROM
(
SELECT 
od.etp_sup_ou_code,
od.distribute_code,
sum(d.settle_amount) settle_amount,
sum(if(d.settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.contract_credit=2,d.settle_amount,0)) paid_amount,
0 adjustment_amount,
0 abnormal_amount,
sum(if(od.distribute_code is null,d.pay_amount-d.refund_amount,d.dis_settle_amount)) dis_settle_amount,
sum(if(d.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.distribute_code is null or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (d.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),if(od.distribute_code is null,d.pay_amount-d.refund_amount,d.dis_settle_amount),0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount,
sum(if(od.state in (11,12,20,26),0,d.coupon_amount-IFNULL(d.coupon_refund_amount,0)))coupon_amount
FROM stat.ord_shopping_order_item_detail d 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.main_order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract c on od.contract_id=c.id
WHERE d.complete_time is not null and d.order_type in ('200017001', '200024001')
and  od.etp_sup_ou_code = '2009657' 
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
group by od.etp_sup_ou_code,od.distribute_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 
od.etp_sup_ou_code,
od.distribute_code,
sum(d.settle_amount) settle_amount,
sum(if(d.settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.contract_credit=2,d.settle_amount,0)) paid_amount,
0 adjustment_amount,
0 abnormal_amount,
sum(if(od.distribute_code is null,d.pay_amount-d.refund_amount,d.dis_settle_amount)) dis_settle_amount,
sum(if(d.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.distribute_code is null or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (d.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),if(od.distribute_code is null,d.pay_amount-d.refund_amount,d.dis_settle_amount),0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount,
sum(if(od.state in (11,12,20,26),0,d.coupon_amount-IFNULL(d.coupon_refund_amount,0)))coupon_amount
FROM stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order_item d 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.main_order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract c on od.contract_id=c.id
WHERE d.complete_time is not null and  d.deliver_type in (1, 2)  and d.product_type=1
and  od.etp_sup_ou_code = '2009657' 
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
group by od.etp_sup_ou_code,od.distribute_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 
od.etp_sup_ou_code,
od.distribute_code,
sum(d.settle_amount) settle_amount,
sum(if(d.settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.contract_credit=2,d.settle_amount,0)) paid_amount,
0 adjustment_amount,
0 abnormal_amount,
sum(if(od.distribute_code is null,d.pay_amount-d.refund_amount,d.dis_settle_amount)) dis_settle_amount,
sum(if(d.dis_settle in (3,4,5,6) or d.distribute_code is null or d.dis_contract_credit=2 or (od.distribute_mode>=20 and od.pay_mode_sub != 997002),if(od.distribute_code is null,d.pay_amount-d.refund_amount,d.dis_settle_amount),0))received_paid_amount,
0 dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount,
sum(if(od.state in (11,12,20,26),0,d.coupon_amount-IFNULL(d.coupon_refund_amount,0)))coupon_amount
FROM sunbox.coupon_virtual_product d 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract c on od.contract_id=c.id
WHERE d.use_time is not null 
and  od.etp_sup_ou_code = '2009657' 
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
group by od.etp_sup_ou_code,od.distribute_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 
ad.etp_sup_ou_code,
ad.distribute_code,
0 settle_amount,
sum(if(ad.contract_type in (1,5) and ((s.credit=2 and s.state in (20,31) or (s.credit !=2 and s.state in (4,5)))),(IFNULL(ad.after_settle_amount,0)-IFNULL(ad.settle_amount,0)),0) ) paid_amount,
sum(if(ad.contract_type in (1,5),(IFNULL(ad.after_settle_amount,0)-IFNULL(ad.settle_amount,0)),0)) adjustment_amount,
0 abnormal_amount,

sum(if(ad.contract_type =2 and ((s.credit=2 and s.state=7) or (s.credit !=2 and s.state=5)),(IFNULL(ad.after_settle_amount,0)-IFNULL(ad.settle_amount,0)),0)) received_paid_amount,
sum(if(ad.contract_type=2,(IFNULL(ad.after_settle_amount,0)-IFNULL(ad.settle_amount,0)),0)) dis_adjustment_amount,
0 dis_abnormal_amount,
0 coupon_amount
FROM sunbox.base_etp_settle_adjustment ad 
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on ad.order_id=od.id
LEFT JOIN sunbox.base_etp_settle_statement s on ad.statement_id=s.id

and source=1
and  ad.etp_sup_ou_code = '2009657' 
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
group by ad.etp_sup_ou_code,ad.distribute_code

d.etp_sup_ou_code,

sum(IFNULL(d.supplier_deduction_settle_amount,0)) abnormal_amount,

0 dis_adjustment_amount,
sum(if(d.distribute_code is null and d.cancel_order_type=4,0,IFNULL(d.refund_amount,0))) dis_abnormal_amount,
sum(0-d.coupon_refund_amount) coupon_amount
FROM sunbox.ord_abnormal_order d
left join stat.ord_shopping_delivery_order od on d.order_id=od.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract dis_c on d.dis_contract_id=dis_c.id
LEFT join sunbox.base_etp_contract c on od.contract_id=c.id
WHERE d.refund_approvel_time is not null 
and  d.refund_approvel_state=2
and   d.etp_sup_ou_code = '2009657' 
and  1=1 
and  1=1 
group by  d.etp_sup_ou_code, d.distribute_code
)t
